# Crew NPC bugs: the summary

**Built by `build-index.mjs` from `findings/`; do not edit by hand.** Every open bug, most severe first, and within each severity the easiest fix first. Duplicates, refuted findings and fixed ones are left out. Each bug links to its finding, which has the code, a concrete case, the steps to fix it and how to test it.

Beside each: **confirmed** means a second reviewer tried to prove it wrong and could not. **not checked** means only its finder has looked at it; "finder sure" or "likely" is how sure that finder was. **unsure** means the second reviewer could not settle it.

411 open bugs (45 confirmed), then 91 gaps. 11 findings are closed (duplicates, refuted or fixed) and not listed.

| Severity | Small fix | Medium fix | Large fix | All | Confirmed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| critical | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| high | 30 | 24 | 3 | 57 | 28 |
| medium | 192 | 57 | 2 | 251 | 16 |
| low | 99 | 3 | 0 | 102 | 0 |

Severity: **critical** stops a body, the whole crew or the window for the rest of the round; **high** makes a job fail or loop in a case most rounds will meet, breaks the no-cheats rule, or acts on the wrong person; **medium** is wrong in rarer cases, or noticeable while the work still gets done; **low** is wording, log noise, dead code or a misleading test.

## Bugs: critical (1)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 1

1. **[ASYNC-06](findings/ASYNC-06-home-key-close-every-ui-wipes-the-crew-brains.md)** (confirmed, brain): The Home key, the game's own close-all-windows key, closes the Crew Brain window and wipes every crew member's memory
   - Fix: Have the brain link catch the close-all key signal on its owner's mob and close every other window itself, leaving the Crew Brain open

## Bugs: high (57)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 30

2. **[API-01](findings/API-01-could-not-reach-read-as-would-not-go.md)** (confirmed, core): A throw out that could not reach the stranger is read as the stranger refusing to go, and earns them a trespass warrant
   - Fix: Narrow WOULD_NOT_GO in wanted.ts to the put_out line ending they got away from you and the cannot-get-a-hold line, or better send a would_not_go details field from the server and test that
3. **[CHEAT-07](findings/CHEAT-07-order-book-written-by-code-even-in-the-dark.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): The Quartermaster writes its order book by putting text straight onto the paper, so it writes in the dark, without the pen in its writing hand, and leaves no paper log
   - Fix: Send each line through the paper's own add_text handler as the body, the way work_timer does for a cell timer, with the pen in the active hand or on the clipboard, and say why when nothing was added
4. **[CHEAT-09](findings/CHEAT-09-cleaner-grenade-primed-by-calling-arm-grenade.md)** (confirmed, janitor): A janitor primes a cleaner grenade by calling arm_grenade, skipping the use-in-hand checks, and counts a spent casing as a live grenade
   - Fix: Prime it the way a player does, with body.execute_mode() on the grenade in the active hand, throw only if it is then active, and do not count a used casing as a grenade
5. **[CHEAT-16](findings/CHEAT-16-tidying-picks-up-and-sets-down-by-code.md)** (confirmed, hands): Tidying picks a thing up with put_in_hands and sets it on a table with transferItemToLoc, not by the clicks a player makes
   - Fix: Pick up with click_as_body on the thing with an empty hand, put down with click_as_body on the table or bin with it in the active hand, shut a locker with a click, and skip flipped tables
6. **[ENG-01](findings/ENG-01-emitters-that-will-not-go-off-are-tried-for-ever-and-nobody-is-told.md)** (confirmed, engineering): An emitter that will not switch off is tried for ever, and neither the Chief Engineer nor the Captain is told the engine is still firing
   - Fix: Count failed switch_off and switch_on steps per emitter as the lighting steps are counted, after two move on to the next emitter, and at the end tell the Chief Engineer which would not go off and why, who tells the Captain
7. **[RT-01](findings/RT-01-clean-click-thrown-away-by-click-cooldown.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): One spray in five is followed by a click the game throws away, and the mess is written off as one that will not come off
   - Fix: Wait out the body's own click cooldown before the click in clean_mess, and do not mark a mess stubborn when the click never landed
8. **[SEC-01](findings/SEC-01-stunned-or-dead-officer-keeps-stepping.md)** (confirmed, security): An officer that is stunned, out cold or dead keeps stepping after its target and across a cell
   - Fix: Before every body.Move in close_with and walk_steps, stop unless the body has MOBILITY_MOVE, is not dead and is not buckled, the check the wander already makes
9. **[SECT-01](findings/SECT-01-do-not-arrest-and-questions-declare-a-warrant.md)** (confirmed, security): Do not arrest X, and a question such as Is there a warrant for X, each declare a warrant on X
   - Fix: In readWarrant return null when the few words just before the match in the same clause hold a negation, or the line is a question that is not a polite order, and let the LLM reader take it from there
10. **[SUP-01](findings/SUP-01-orders-and-shuttle-work-at-a-dead-console.md)** (confirmed, supply): A technician orders and sends the shuttle at a supply console that has no power or is broken
   - Fix: Have place_order and send_shuttle_back ask console.can_interact(body) first (or order through work_window) and answer that the console is dead when it says no
11. **[CORE-01](findings/CORE-01-new-walk-mid-walk-keeps-going-to-the-old-spot.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A walk given while another walk is under way is never walked, the body carries on to the old spot and the new walk is then failed
   - Fix: In start_walk, when a walk is already running, stop the old move loop (ai_movement.stop_moving_towards) before setting the new target, so the walk leaf starts a fresh loop with the new target and the right required_dist
12. **[HAND-12](findings/HAND-12-search-opens-a-large-wooden-crate-with-no-crowbar.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A search or a fetch opens a large wooden crate with no crowbar, looks inside and shuts it again, which no player can do
   - Fix: Leave crate/large out of storage_to_search and out of take_from_container until a crowbar step is built, the way body bags and cardboard boxes are left out
13. **[KNA-29](findings/KNA-29-fire-doors-blamed-on-the-wrong-room-officer-stuck-in-its-office.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A fire door shut by the next room's pulled alarm is reported as shut by a real alarm in the body's own room, so nobody resets it and the officer was held in its office for the rest of the round
   - Fix: In fire_door_report take the room whose alarm was raised by hand over one it only spread to, as the fault display on a fire alarm shows, and say the room the alarm is in
14. **[MAP-05](findings/MAP-05-spawn-looks-only-at-the-lowest-floor-so-icebox-puts-the-whole-crew-at-the-owners-feet.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The standing crew is placed only on the lowest station floor, so on IceBox all eleven are piled at the owner's feet and on the other multi-floor maps half are, or land in the wrong department
   - Fix: Look for each job's rooms on every station level in crew_npc_spawn_turf, trying the rooms in order across all levels before the broad fallbacks, and never fall back to the owner's turf off the station
15. **[MAP-07](findings/MAP-07-crew-walk-normally-with-the-gravity-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): With the station's gravity off the crew walk about as if it were on, which no player can do
   - Fix: Give every crew step the check a player's step gets (no gravity and nothing to push off means no step), in an allowed_to_move override on the crew movement type and in the idle shuffle, and tell the brain the body is floating
16. **[MEM-05](findings/MEM-05-an-order-said-to-someone-else-is-taken-on-when-the-superior-next-speaks-to-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): An order a superior gave someone else is taken on as its own when the superior next speaks to it
   - Fix: In workInWords read only the lines the report marks as speaking to you or to everyone there, and only those said since the NPC last answered
17. **[PARSE-01](findings/PARSE-01-clean-the-bar-is-not-read-as-a-mess.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Clean the bar, mop the kitchen, puked and vomited are not read as a mess, so a typed call to a janitor is taken as word its supplies have come
   - Fix: Add the verbs of asking for cleaning (clean, mop, wipe, scrub, tidy, sweep) and the past and -ing forms of the mess words to MESS_WORDS, and let a word that begins with a mess word count
18. **[QM-02](findings/QM-02-order-given-again-for-good-to-a-technician-who-never-answers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): An order is given to a technician who is down, dead or a human player, and given to the same one again every minute for the rest of the round
   - Fix: Leave out technicians who are down or cuffed when picking, count how often an order has gone unanswered and after two give it to another free technician, and take a plain ok from the technician it was given to as taken
19. **[QM-08](findings/QM-08-captain-yes-answers-the-oldest-question-not-the-last-asked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): With two orders waiting on the Captain, a plain yes or no is taken as the answer to the first ever asked, not to the question the Captain has just been sent
   - Fix: In orderAnswered, with no order named, take the order asked about most recently, and when more than one is waiting and the answer names none, ask which one before acting
20. **[QM-14](findings/QM-14-i-have-that-held-back-longer-each-time-and-blocks-the-pda-queue.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The Quartermaster's I have that to a technician is held back longer each time it is said, till the technician gives up on it, and while held back it stops every PDA message behind it
   - Fix: Do not count a line said word for word as a failure, and in the toTell step take the first line that is not held back rather than giving up when the first one is
21. **[SECT-06](findings/SECT-06-any-leave-from-its-head-sends-it-out-of-the-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Any line from its head or the Captain with leave, get out or out of here in it sends a crew member out of the room it is in and keeps it out ten minutes
   - Fix: Take it as an order to leave only when the leave word has the room, here, or nothing after it as its object, with no negation before it
22. **[SECT-07](findings/SECT-07-head-saying-take-the-crates-out-has-a-sent-for-janitor-put-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A head saying take the crates out, or remove the empty crates, in its own room has a janitor it sent for walked out by the arm and struck off the call
   - Fix: Take a put-out order only when the line names a person or says him, her, them or that one as the object of the verb, and never pick the lone stranger when nobody was named
23. **[SECT-11](findings/SECT-11-warrant-declared-while-the-officer-is-out-is-lost-on-try-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant declared while the officer is out hurt is marked given, so after try again the Head of Security hands it back and the officer is never told of it
   - Fix: When try again clears officerOut, set every warrant the officer was never given back to given no, so the give task hands it over
24. **[TRB-01](findings/TRB-01-wanted-person-cuffed-by-the-captain-is-never-taken-in.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone wanted whom the Captain or any player has cuffed is left standing in cuffs, the warrant never served and nobody told
   - Fix: In serveStep leave a cuffed person to someone else only while another security crew member is in sight beside them, otherwise take them by the arm with how quiet, which the server already handles
25. **[TRB-02](findings/TRB-02-pardon-while-the-cuffs-are-going-on-leaves-them-held-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A pardon or a withdrawn warrant that comes while the cuffs are going on leaves the person cuffed and held by the arm for the rest of the round
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing, when an arrest step comes back with the cuffs on and the warrant is no longer held, push a let-go for that person, and in syncBeat let go of anyone held by the arm on no warrant
26. **[TRB-03](findings/TRB-03-officer-keeps-a-warrant-the-head-of-security-served-and-arrests-again-on-release.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): When the officer is out hurt both it and the Head of Security hold each warrant, and whichever did not make the arrest arrests the prisoner again when the cell opens
   - Fix: When a warrant is served, have the desk tell every other holder to drop it (a let-go line with the reason served, or a new served line), and on hurt have the officer hand its warrants back
27. **[JAN-04](findings/JAN-04-water-seen-through-a-window-is-walked-at-again-and-again.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cleaning): A sink or mop bucket seen through a window in a room the body cannot enter is taken as water to hand, and a janitor with a dry mop tries to walk to it every time it is told to clean
   - Fix: Pick water only where the body can get to it - not in a room locked to it, and not one it failed to walk to lately - and remember a water source it could not reach as fire_alarms_failed does
28. **[LOGA-01](findings/LOGA-01-janitor-sent-to-delivery-office-is-refused-at-the-cargo-bay-door.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): A janitor sent for to the Delivery Office who asks at the Cargo Bay door is told nobody sent for it, because the office also has a door into the security post
   - Fix: Leave out of the outer-room test any door that opens from a room the crew at large cannot walk into, so the Delivery Office is known to be reached through the Cargo Bay
29. **[LOGA-03](findings/LOGA-03-a-mop-clicked-on-a-cobweb-or-rubble-removes-it-but-janitors-are-told-it-needs-soap.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): A mop clicked on a cobweb or rubble takes it up, but the body only ever mops the floor under it, so every cobweb and pile of rubble is called beyond the mop and starts a round-long soap-or-rag loop
   - Fix: For a mop, click the mess itself when it is not is_mopped, and judge a mop by its cleaner strength alone in can_clean_mess, and take cobweb and rubble out of SCRUB_KINDS for a janitor holding a mop
30. **[MULTI-08](findings/MULTI-08-janitor-being-seen-out-after-its-work-gets-a-trespass-warrant-when-the-walk-out-fails.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A janitor being seen out after the job it was sent for is reported as one who would not go, and gets a trespass warrant, whenever the walk out fails for any reason of the technician's own
   - Fix: Report would_not_go from the server only when the person broke the hold themselves, and never push someone who was sent for (stranger.sent) onto couldNot
31. **[TRC-01](findings/TRC-01-tidying-shuts-a-crate-or-locker-on-a-person.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): Tidying shuts an open crate on a person lying on its tile, or a locker on a person standing in it, and shuts them inside
   - Fix: In wants_shutting, and again in tidy_step just before close, leave the container open if any living mob bigger than tiny is on its tile

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 24

32. **[ARR-02](findings/ARR-02-officer-walked-out-of-a-room-takes-it-for-an-attack.md)** (confirmed, security): An officer walked out of a locked room by its keeper takes that for an attack, and batons them or adds five minutes for resisting
   - Fix: In on_grabbed, a tick later, tell nothing of a hold by whoever is walking the body out or arresting it, and do not see security out of a room while it has a warrant to serve there
33. **[ASYNC-08](findings/ASYNC-08-order-lost-if-the-one-who-gave-it-walks-out-of-view-before-the-npcs-turn.md)** (confirmed, brain): An order or word of work is lost if whoever gave it has walked out of sight by the time the NPC's turn with the model comes
   - Fix: Keep who each speaker was (name, superior or not) when the line is heard, and have buildTalk and think go by that, not by who is in view when the model is asked
34. **[CARGO-02](findings/CARGO-02-arrival-sent-by-pda-never-reaches-the-quartermaster.md)** (confirmed, cargo): When a technician cannot find the Quartermaster, word that an order came in goes to the head only, and the Quartermaster never gives that technician another order
   - Fix: In the PDA fall-back for an order given by the Quartermaster, also send the Quartermaster the has-come-in line by PDA, which its readsMessage already reads - the owner must first allow a PDA between technician and Quartermaster, which the plan rules out
35. **[CHEAT-01](findings/CHEAT-01-crew-bodies-walk-through-people.md)** (confirmed, core): Every crew body is given PASSMOB and walks straight through people, even someone in combat mode blocking a doorway
   - Fix: Drop PASSMOB from crew bodies and set diagonal_flags to DIAGONAL_REMOVE_ALL on the crew movement datum, so every step is straight and the game's own mob swap passes them
36. **[CHEAT-08](findings/CHEAT-08-mail-taken-out-of-the-crate-all-at-once-by-code.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Every letter in a mail crate goes into the technician's bag at once by code, with no click on any letter, the crate or the bag
   - Fix: For each letter in turn click it into an empty hand and click the bag with it by stow_in_bag, a click gap apart, dropping junk off the crate's tile, and stop if the errand ends or the crate is out of reach
37. **[CHEAT-14](findings/CHEAT-14-pda-used-switched-off-broken-blind-and-free-of-power.md)** (confirmed, core): Crew bodies send PDA messages with the PDA switched off, broken or with its sending turned off, while blind, to someone with receiving off, and without ever drawing its battery
   - Fix: Before sending, require what the PDA's screen requires - switched on by turn_on, not broken, a body that can read it, sending enabled - say which failed, and send through the messenger's send_message rather than send_message_signal; reading needs no change
38. **[KNA-01](findings/KNA-01-second-door-ask-wipes-the-first.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A second ask for a door wipes out the first, so a technician says it is coming and never comes
   - Fix: Keep door asks as a list by asker, serve them oldest first, and strike one only when its door has been opened or it has run out
39. **[KNB-04](findings/KNB-04-door-opened-by-code-and-its-closing-switched-off.md)** (confirmed, doors): A technician opens a door for someone by calling the door's open proc and switching its auto-close off, not by a click
   - Fix: Open and shut the door with click_as_body from beside it, leave autoclose alone, and click it open again if it shuts before the person is through
40. **[KNB-06](findings/KNB-06-crate-contents-moved-by-code-and-galoshes-made-at-spawn.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Two cheats from the no-cheats plan are still in - a crate is unpacked by forceMove onto the tiles round it, and a janitor's galoshes are made at spawn
   - Fix: Unpack by opening the crate in place and leaving its contents on its own tile, pull it clear before shutting it, and delete the galoshes swap once the owner has ruled on mopped tiles
41. **[KNB-13](findings/KNB-13-step-aside-ask-comes-after-the-haul-is-lost-and-is-reworded.md)** (confirmed, driver): A hauler never asks whoever its crate caught on to step aside - the ask waits until every regrip is used up, and then the model's own line is said in its place
   - Fix: Say the step-aside ask word for word and while the body is busy taking the crate up again, and have wait_for_way wait until the person has moved
42. **[QM-01](findings/QM-01-captain-answer-read-by-any-no-word.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): Any word like no in anything the Captain sends refuses the order waiting on them, and a new order sent with an ok or a no in it is thrown away
   - Fix: Stop a bare "no" before a noun counting as a refusal, weigh yes against no instead of no first and ask back when both or neither are found, and when the line also names a crate take that as a new order and ask about the waiting one
43. **[SEC-03](findings/SEC-03-called-off-arrest-keeps-running.md)** (confirmed, security): An arrest or a jailing that is called off keeps running, so an officer that breaks off hurt goes on fighting
   - Fix: Have make_arrest, baton_hits, close_with, put_cuffs_on, walk_steps, put_in_cell, set_free and the kit procs stop after any sleep once errand_serial is no longer the one they began with
44. **[SECT-02](findings/SECT-02-free-release-let-go-anywhere-in-a-line-is-a-pardon.md)** (confirmed, security): Any line from the Captain with free, release or let go in it that names someone wanted or in a cell pardons them
   - Fix: Take a pardon only when the pardon word comes right before the name, with no negation in front of it, and read the warrant words before the pardon words
45. **[SECT-03](findings/SECT-03-unknown-name-swallows-the-words-after-it.md)** (confirmed, security): A warrant on someone the reader does not know by name takes up to four words as the name, so Arrest Pun Pun in the bar is a warrant on Pun Pun in the
   - Fix: For a name it does not know, stop the name at the first word that cannot be part of one (who, in, at, is, he, because, a dash) and prefer a run of capitalised words when the line has capitals
46. **[KNB-08](findings/KNB-08-held-door-to-an-outer-room-is-wasted-on-work-underfoot.md)** (confirmed, driver): A door held open into an outer room is not gone through - the held door wipes every back-off, and work where the janitor stands wins - so it asks at the same door again and again
   - Fix: Put first the ready step that walks through the held door, whatever room its task is for, and stop a held door from clearing the back-off of work in the room the body is already in
47. **[TRUST-11](findings/TRUST-11-a-heads-own-chatter-is-taken-as-an-order-by-the-crew-who-hear-it.md)** (confirmed, brain): What the model has a head say in passing is taken by the crew who hear it as that head's order, so any player who gets a head talking about an arrest gets a warrant
   - Fix: Before a line the model wrote is said, test it against the words other crew act on, and say the plain line instead when it would read as a warrant, pardon, order or summons that code did not decide
48. **[CORE-03](findings/CORE-03-walk-follows-a-person-out-of-sight-with-perfect-knowledge.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A body walking up to someone follows them wherever they go, out of sight and through rooms, for 30 seconds, and an officer chases a suspect the same way for 3 minutes
   - Fix: In the walk and reach leaves, when the target is a mob, check each tick that it is still in view, and once it has been out of view a few seconds walk to the spot it was last seen and end there with they went out of sight
49. **[LOGB-01](findings/LOGB-01-janitor-shut-in-the-hops-office-for-the-rest-of-the-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A janitor shut in the Head of Personnel's Office stays there for the rest of the round, with the head in the room and asked twice
   - Fix: Let anyone whose own ID opens the room open its door to let out someone inside who asks, not only cargo, and send a head the head form of the shut-in line even when its ID opens the door
50. **[LOGB-02](findings/LOGB-02-meeting-call-mid-haul-loses-the-unpacked-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): A meeting called while a janitor hauls a collected crate makes its brain lose the haul, so it unpacks the crate, then tells its head the crate is lost
   - Fix: Do not let a step that stays put (a PDA reply) take the place of brain.lastAct while a walk or haul is still waiting on its result, keep it aside and match results to either
51. **[QM-10](findings/QM-10-question-or-cancel-about-an-order-is-taken-as-a-new-order.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): A head or the Captain asking about an order, or saying to cancel one, has a new order placed for them, and there is no way to cancel an order at all
   - Fix: Take a line as a new order only if it asks for something (no question about an order, no cancel or do not), answer questions from the book in code, and add a cancel that refuses an order not yet given
52. **[SENSE-08](findings/SENSE-08-captain-or-head-without-a-worn-id-can-be-walked-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The Captain or a head of staff who is not wearing their ID is a stranger to every keeper of a room, and can be taken by the arm and walked out
   - Fix: Have why_not_put_out also refuse anyone whose own face shows and whose name the crew manifest gives as the Captain or a head, and let the window remember who it has seen to be command
53. **[TRUST-02](findings/TRUST-02-forged-pda-sender-taken-for-the-captain.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A PDA message with a made-up sender, from the message monitor or a virus disk, is taken as from the Captain or any head it names
   - Fix: Have on_pda_message say whether the message came from a real PDA that can be answered, and have the window take no warrant, pardon, approval, order or summons from one that cannot
54. **[TRUST-05](findings/TRUST-05-any-security-pda-gets-any-door-forced-open.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): Any PDA that shows a security job can have an engineer pry open any door aboard, the Armory and the Vault among them, and leave it standing open
   - Fix: Take a forcing request only from whoever keeps security's list, only for a warrant engineering can check and a room that is not a secure store, and have the Captain say yes to anything in command or security
55. **[PERF-02](findings/PERF-02-each-sense-event-sends-the-whole-crew-at-once.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): Each sense event sends the whole crew's state at once, one update per event even when many come in one tick, about 150 KB each at 11 crew and 600 KB at 40, 90 percent of it old events
   - Fix: Let on_sense_event ask for one update at the end of the tick instead of one at once, and send each body's events newer than its acked_seq only

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 3

56. **[CARGO-01](findings/CARGO-01-order-that-fails-after-placing-is-told-to-nobody.md)** (confirmed, cargo): An order that fails after it was placed is told to nobody, and the Quartermaster's book keeps it as given for good
   - Fix: Have the server owe a notice of kind failed when a placed order is given up, and have the technician pass it on like any other word (to the Quartermaster face to face, or to whoever ordered by PDA)
57. **[HOLE-01](findings/HOLE-01-any-card-that-says-captain-is-the-captain.md)** (confirmed, design): Anyone holding or wearing a card whose job text has "captain" in it is obeyed as the Captain
   - Fix: Have the server work out each person's rank from the card they wear and whether its name matches their face, send that as a field, and have the window go by that field and never by words in the job text
58. **[KNA-04](findings/KNA-04-helper-list-of-cheats-confirmed-in-hands-doors-alarm.md)** (confirmed, hands): The list of cheats a helper reported in older code was never checked - all of it is true and still in the code
   - Fix: Replace each direct call with the click a player makes, starting with hand_over, which puts things into a player's hand

## Bugs: medium (251)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 192

59. **[ARR-09](findings/ARR-09-told-to-try-again-a-hurt-officer-breaks-off-again-at-once.md)** (confirmed, security): Told to try again, security that is still under half its health breaks off again the same second, and says so again
   - Fix: Remember the health it was told to try again at, and break off again only when it has lost a good deal more since
60. **[BRAIN-01](findings/BRAIN-01-deaf-to-a-player-after-six-replies.md)** (confirmed, brain): After six replies to a player an NPC stops hearing them until they keep quiet for 30 seconds
   - Fix: Count replies to a player over a rolling minute, set lastHeardAt only for a line that is let through, and make out an order by code from a capped line said by someone the NPC answers to
61. **[BRAIN-03](findings/BRAIN-03-dropped-line-asked-again-at-once-in-a-tight-loop.md)** (confirmed, brain): A line dropped before the model is asked is asked for again at once, in a loop that uses up the body's tool calls
   - Fix: Make letInStep's sayIf test only the door it waits at, and when think drops a line for its sayIf hold the driver off a few seconds and clear the mustSay fields
62. **[DOOR-11](findings/DOOR-11-fire-alarm-reset-reported-when-nothing-was-reset.md)** (confirmed, doors): Resetting a fire alarm is reported as done when the alarm has no power or cannot be reset
   - Fix: Reset the alarm by the right click a player uses, then look at the room and answer by whether its alarm is in fact off
63. **[HAND-01](findings/HAND-01-click-thrown-away-by-the-click-cooldown-is-counted-as-made.md)** (confirmed, hands): A click the game throws away for coming too soon is counted as made, so the cuffs never go on after a third baton hit
   - Fix: In click_as_body wait out the body's own next_move before a plain click, and return FALSE if the game would still drop it
64. **[LIFE-05](findings/LIFE-05-stunned-mid-errand-a-second-copy-of-the-errand-starts.md)** (confirmed, core): A body stunned in the middle of a long errand starts a second copy of the same errand when it gets up, while the first is still running
   - Fix: Keep a per-controller flag that an errand run is in flight, cleared however the run ends, and have crew_npc_do_errand and the errand's crew_npc_reach wait on it instead of starting a second run or walking against the first
65. **[SECT-22](findings/SECT-22-drop-or-cancel-anywhere-before-warrant-withdraws-it.md)** (confirmed, security): Drop, call off or cancel anywhere before the word warrant takes a warrant back, even Don't cancel the warrant, and a new warrant in the same line is lost
   - Fix: Take a warrant back only when the cancel verb has the warrant (or "the arrest of" the person) as its object within two words, with no negation in front; otherwise fall through to the pardon and warrant readers as now
66. **[DESK-02](findings/DESK-02-second-call-to-a-locked-room-is-given-up-before-the-janitor-sets-off.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Once a janitor has been let into a room, its next call to that room is given up as nobody let you in before it sets off
   - Fix: In syncTasks delete brain.letInAsks for the room the janitor stands in and for any door no open via mess task asks at, so each new call starts with a knock
67. **[ENG-06](findings/ENG-06-chief-takes-engine-words-from-the-engineers-chat-and-relight-skips-emitters-last.md)** (confirmed, engineering): The Chief Engineer takes "the engine is lit" or "the emitters are off" from anything its engineer says, and the relight that follows can switch the emitters on before the cooling is running
   - Fix: Take each of the engineer's set words only when the line begins with that whole fixed line (litLine(chief name) and so on; a remark may follow it), and let the engineer take a relight order only once the engine is lit, with RELIGHT not ready while lighting(engine)
68. **[ARR-03](findings/ARR-03-baton-used-on-a-head-of-staff-with-no-warrant.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An officer stops a head of staff with the baton when there is no warrant, which is laying a hand on a head
   - Fix: Refuse the baton with no warrant on anyone who is command, in the stop_attacker task and in tool_arrest, and report it instead
69. **[ARR-05](findings/ARR-05-word-for-head-of-security-stuck-on-a-pda-that-will-not-send.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Word for the Head of Security that has gone to the PDA once is never said to its face, so with PDAs down it is never told
   - Fix: In tellHead say the word face to face whenever the Head of Security is in sight, and after a PDA send fails go to the post to find them
70. **[ARR-10](findings/ARR-10-short-of-cuffs-with-them-in-sight-it-neither-fetches-nor-tells.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Short of cuffs, or of a working baton once force is called for, with the person in sight it neither goes for its kit nor tells anyone
   - Fix: Let wantsKit send it for its kit while on lead when the kit is what stops the arrest, and tell whoever keeps the list at once that it is short
71. **[ARR-11](findings/ARR-11-one-hallway-it-cannot-walk-to-stops-the-whole-search.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): One main hallway it cannot walk to stops the whole search, and it stands still between ever longer tries at that one hallway
   - Fix: Skip a hallway in blockedPlaces, and count a walk to a hallway that came to nothing as that hallway looked at, so the round goes on to the next
72. **[ARR-12](findings/ARR-12-server-refusing-to-arrest-a-captain-card-is-read-as-will-not-stand-still.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The server refusing an arrest because the person carries a Captain's ID is read as them not standing still, and the arrest line is said to them for ever
   - Fix: Read the reasons captain, self and how in beatAfterActing as final for that person, stop trying them, and tell whoever keeps the list why in plain words
73. **[ARR-14](findings/ARR-14-waiting-at-a-door-it-asked-to-be-let-through-it-walks-off-on-other-work.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Having asked to be let in at a door, security walks off on its other warrant or for its kit, and is not there when the door is opened
   - Fix: Set asked true on the wait in letInStep once it is at the door, as the janitor's wait at a door does, so the wait outranks its other asked work
74. **[ARR-19](findings/ARR-19-someone-who-fought-back-and-is-behind-a-locked-counter-is-never-asked-about.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone in sight across a locked counter who has fought back, or who stands within two tiles, is never asked to be let in to, and security walks, shouts and fails at them for ever
   - Fix: Gate the let-in branch on shutOut alone, for the room they are in, dropping both the not-resisted and the more-than-two-tiles conditions
75. **[ASYNC-05](findings/ASYNC-05-word-to-tell-struck-off-when-queued-and-lost-if-they-walk-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Word meant for someone face to face is struck off the moment it is queued for the model, and is lost if they walk out of sight before it is said
   - Fix: Strike a spoken tell off in afterSaying, once the line has gone out with its person still in view, not in noteDone when it is handed to the model
76. **[ASYNC-07](findings/ASYNC-07-optional-remark-stops-the-body-mid-walk-while-the-model-is-asked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A remark the NPC may or may not make stops its body mid-walk, and holds back its next walk, for as long as the model takes to be asked
   - Fix: Do not send hold, and do not count the NPC as talking in drive, when all it is queued for is a remark of its own, and only stand still once the model has given a line to say
77. **[BRAIN-05](findings/BRAIN-05-lead-offer-made-on-ordinary-words.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A janitor is offered "lead them somewhere" on words like take, way and get to, and walks off to a room nobody asked for
   - Fix: Offer the walk only when a line said to this NPC both asks the way and names a room, and have code check a go_to against what was said as it does an order
78. **[BRAIN-06](findings/BRAIN-06-anyone-named-in-its-own-line-becomes-who-it-is-talking-with.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Anyone the NPC names in its own line, even in passing or by a word like hope or may, becomes who it is talking with, and the one it was answering is dropped
   - Fix: After saying a line, set inTalkWith only to someone the line calls on (callsOn from addressing.ts) or else leave it on the speaker it was answering
79. **[BRAIN-07](findings/BRAIN-07-line-no-longer-needed-is-said-when-the-model-fails-or-someone-spoke.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A line that has stopped needing saying while the model thought is said all the same when the call fails, and is kept inside the answer when someone had also spoken
   - Fix: Test mustSayIf again in the catch of think before the plain line is said, and when it is false with speakers present ask that the line be left out or say the plain answer only
80. **[BRAIN-09](findings/BRAIN-09-question-put-as-a-word-for-word-line-is-due-is-never-answered.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Someone who speaks to an NPC just as a word-for-word line is due gets that line and a remark, never an answer, and is not heard again
   - Fix: When a word-for-word line goes out in a call that also had speakers, put the speakers and their lines back and wake the NPC again so the next call answers them, unless the line was said to one of them
81. **[BRAIN-12](findings/BRAIN-12-any-line-said-counts-as-telling-everyone-in-view-their-work-is-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Any line the NPC says marks every finished task whose asker is in view as reported, so a greeting or one done to Ann leaves the Captain never told
   - Fix: Mark a finished task reported only when the line said names its asker and was the done line or holds the done words, and say one done line per asker
82. **[CARGO-03](findings/CARGO-03-did-not-go-through-is-said-once-and-not-confirmed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Word that an order did not go through is said once, only if the Quartermaster is in sight within two minutes, and nothing checks it was heard
   - Fix: Pass the did-not-go-through word through tellQuartermaster as a task of its own, with the same I-have-that answer and PDA fall-back as the other three words
83. **[CARGO-05](findings/CARGO-05-crate-count-read-only-right-before-the-word-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): How many crates is read only when the number stands right before the word crate, so two janitorial crates is one crate, and five is one
   - Fix: Read the count from any number in the same clause as the kind (digits, one to ten, a couple, x2), and cap it at the server's four instead of falling back to one
84. **[CARGO-07](findings/CARGO-07-dead-model-fallback-orders-on-any-mention-of-order-or-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): With the model down, a head who says the word order or crate for any reason has a Janitorial Supplies Crate ordered for them
   - Fix: In hears, place an order only when the words name a kind of crate that can be ordered and are put as an ask, and never fall back to the first crate on the list
85. **[CARGO-08](findings/CARGO-08-come-for-my-crate-with-no-number-is-told-no-such-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Someone who comes for their own crate and does not give the number in a set form is told no crate is held by that number
   - Fix: In crateMeant fall back to the crates held for the speaker, read more ways of giving a number, and say there is no crate for you instead of by that number when none was given
86. **[CARGO-11](findings/CARGO-11-no-janitor-called-while-the-rooms-keeper-is-gone.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Once the rooms are given to one technician, the other never sends for a janitor, even when that technician is dead, in the brig or gone
   - Fix: In tidyStep leave the call to the keeper only while leftTo says they are about, as every other piece of the standing work does
87. **[CARGO-12](findings/CARGO-12-workmate-down-or-in-cuffs-still-counts-as-about.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A workmate lying knocked out, dead or in cuffs in plain sight still counts as about, so their share of the work is left to them for good
   - Fix: Write one helper, ableWorkmate, that needs the person in view to be neither down nor cuffed, and use it in leftTo, doorIsMine, the knock rule and visitorToMind
88. **[CARGO-13](findings/CARGO-13-collector-asks-the-same-technician-every-minute-with-no-end.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Someone sent for a crate asks the first technician in sight every minute for up to half an hour, even one who is down, and then drops the errand without telling anyone
   - Fix: Ask a technician who is on their feet, turn to another after an ask that brought nothing, and after three asks tell the head who sent it and put the errand off
89. **[CARGO-14](findings/CARGO-14-lights-for-the-janitor-orders-a-janitorial-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Light bulbs for the janitor is ordered as a Janitorial Supplies Crate, because each clause gives one kind only, the first on the list, and janitor names the janitorial crate
   - Fix: In itemsAskedFor strip who the order is for before matching, split on question and exclamation marks too, and take every kind a clause names by its own words rather than the first kind on the list
90. **[CARGO-15](findings/CARGO-15-order-that-says-someone-will-collect-it-is-taken-for-a-pickup.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): An order that says who will come for the crate, I'll send someone to pick it up, is taken for someone come to collect, told no crate is held, and not placed
   - Fix: Take a line as someone come for a crate only when it does not also ask for one to be ordered, and read the collect words only when they are about a crate that is already here
91. **[CHEAT-02](findings/CHEAT-02-who-can-open-a-door-read-off-everyones-id-card.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Who to ask to open a door is found by reading every crew member's ID card and the place of their PDA, from anywhere
   - Fix: Go by the name and job the PDA's contact list shows and the access that job is given, not by the card each person carries or where their PDA is
92. **[CHEAT-03](findings/CHEAT-03-free-cell-picked-from-anywhere-by-reading-every-cell.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An officer picks a free brig cell from wherever it makes the arrest, by reading every cell's timer and who is inside, unseen
   - Fix: Choose the cell from what the body last saw of the cells, or Cell 1 if it has seen none, and pick again at the brig once the cells are in view
93. **[CHEAT-10](findings/CHEAT-10-who-belongs-and-who-outranks-read-off-card-access.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Whether someone in view belongs in a post, or outranks the body, is read off the hidden access list and trim of their card, not the job the card shows
   - Fix: Judge belongs and command from the job title the card shows and the access that job is given, the way a player reading the card would
94. **[CHEAT-13](findings/CHEAT-13-technician-knows-the-cargo-budget-from-anywhere.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A cargo technician refuses an order for want of money wherever it stands, reading the cargo budget it has no way to see
   - Fix: Check the budget at the console in place_order, as the console itself shows it, or from a budget program on the technician's PDA, never before it walks there
95. **[CHK-07](findings/CHK-07-walked-out-on-purpose-still-counts-as-in-the-room-for-ten-seconds.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A body that walks out of a room on purpose still counts as in it for ten seconds, so a Quartermaster in its office calls its meeting by PDA as if it stood in the bay
   - Fix: Record leftPlace in ingest only when the body was not walking and the driver has no walk of its own in hand, so stillIn means pushed out and not walked out
96. **[CORE-02](findings/CORE-02-stunned-body-hears-nothing-and-pda-messages-are-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A body that is stunned or paralysed for a moment is treated as senseless, so what is said to it is not heard and a PDA message that comes in then is lost for good
   - Fix: Make can_sense depend on the body (alive, conscious, no player in it), not on ai_status, and keep PDA messages that come while it cannot sense to read when it can
97. **[CORE-07](findings/CORE-07-slow-tool-finishes-over-a-newer-tool-call.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A tool that takes time to choose (explore, force_door, go_to_door) starts its walk when it is done even if a newer tool call came in meanwhile, and the newer one is lost without a word
   - Fix: Count accepted tool calls on the controller, have each slow tool note the count when it starts and, when it is done choosing, drop its walk and say nothing if the count has moved on
98. **[CORE-09](findings/CORE-09-body-holding-another-id-takes-its-job-for-its-own.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A crew member holding someone else's ID card, or a PDA with one in it, takes that card's job for its own, on the server and in the window, for as long as it holds it
   - Fix: Read the body's own job from the card it wears first (get_idcard with hand_first FALSE), and send that same job_title() to the window instead of get_assignment
99. **[CORE-10](findings/CORE-10-window-opened-on-the-lobby-closes-when-the-owner-joins.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): When the owner is still in the lobby ten seconds into the round, the brain window is opened on the lobby mob and is shut the moment they join or observe, so no crew member is driven until they reopen it by hand
   - Fix: In spawn_test_crew, when the owner's mob is a lobby mob, do not open the window then, and open it for them as soon as they have a body or a ghost (listen for their client changing mob)
100. **[CORE-11](findings/CORE-11-walk-held-back-by-a-grab-or-chair-is-told-no-way-through.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A walk the body cannot take because someone has hold of it, it is cuffed and pulled, or it is buckled to a chair, is told there is no way through, with all that follows
   - Fix: In the walk leaf, when the move loop gave up because the body was not allowed to move, say why from what the body can feel (held, cuffed and held, buckled, off its feet) instead of CREW_NPC_NO_WAY, and do not count it as a way out that failed
101. **[DESK-01](findings/DESK-01-any-pda-message-a-janitor-cannot-read-is-taken-for-supplies-come.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Any PDA message a janitor cannot read is taken to mean its supplies have come, and sends it to the Cargo Lobby
   - Fix: Set suppliesSentAt in the janitor's readsMessage only when the message has the head's fixed words what you asked for has come, and ignore every other message
102. **[DESK-03](findings/DESK-03-dry-mop-and-a-rag-with-no-sink-in-sight-never-goes-to-a-sink.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A janitor with a dry mop and a rag and no sink in sight never goes to a sink, and every mess task is stuck on wetting it here
   - Fix: In plan, take the mopNeedsWater step only when brain.sinkInView, and with no water in sight send a dry mop to a known sink room as supplyStep does, before going to a mess elsewhere
103. **[DESK-05](findings/DESK-05-with-no-head-of-security-and-two-officers-no-warrant-is-served.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): With no Head of Security and two officers, the officer who keeps the list hands every warrant to the other, who does not read it, so nobody serves any
   - Fix: With no Head of Security, have each officer keep and serve its own list (officerAboard returns null for an officer keeping the desk), or have officers read a fellow officer's give, seen and let-go lines with takeWord
104. **[DOOR-01](findings/DOOR-01-held-door-shuts-on-those-not-yet-through.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door held for several people shuts on the rest when the one watched longest goes through first
   - Fix: Count who is still to come through each held door and shut it only when the last of them is through or every hold has run out
105. **[DOOR-04](findings/DOOR-04-dead-door-refused-for-tools-it-does-not-need.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door with no power is refused for want of a screwdriver, a multitool and wire skill, when a crowbar alone opens it
   - Fix: In tool_force_door ask for the screwdriver, the multitool and the wire skill only when the door to be forced has power, and for the crowbar always
106. **[DOOR-09](findings/DOOR-09-room-with-a-door-open-at-that-instant-counts-as-open.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A locked room counts as open to all for the whole round if one of its doors stood open at the instant it was looked at
   - Fix: In the open-way test of crew_npc_room_is_closed pass over any tile that holds an airlock, a windoor or plastic flaps, so only a way with no door on it counts
107. **[DOOR-12](findings/DOOR-12-forced-door-reported-open-with-a-fire-door-shut-under-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door is reported forced open, or standing open, while a shut fire door on the same square still bars the way
   - Fix: Before answering that a door is open, look for a shut fire door on the airlock's square and answer it as fire doors, with the fire_doors detail fire_door_report gives
108. **[DOOR-14](findings/DOOR-14-door-that-will-not-open-gives-no-reason.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door a technician cannot open is answered with one line for four causes, so a door with no power is walked to at every asking and nobody is told why
   - Fix: Give hold_door_for a separate answer and a reason detail for no power, bolted, welded and not your access, refuse a door that stands open only when it is not open, and pass over dead doors in room_door_for
109. **[DRV-01](findings/DRV-01-step-clear-tries-used-up-before-any-step.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The two tries at stepping clear of a doorway are used up while the driver is waiting, so a body that arrives in a doorway mostly stays in it
   - Fix: Count a step clear when the step is issued (in drive, beside noteDone), not when nextStep asks whether one is allowed
110. **[DRV-03](findings/DRV-03-asked-to-step-aside-it-stands-six-seconds.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Asked to step aside, a body stands still for six seconds or more first, because being asked counts as being talked to
   - Fix: Leave step_aside out of the talk hold and the pause after saying (add it to STAYS), and have tool_step_aside end the server's talk hold
111. **[DRV-07](findings/DRV-07-shut-in-asks-counted-when-queued-and-never-made-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Shut in, a person counts as asked for the door the moment the line is queued, and nobody is asked or knocked for a second time in that stay
   - Fix: Mark a helper as asked only when the line is really said, and let an ask and a knock be made again after a couple of minutes with nobody come
112. **[DRV-11](findings/DRV-11-shut-in-and-unable-to-reach-the-door-it-never-sends-word.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Shut in and unable to get to the door, a body never knocks and never sends PDA word, because both wait on it standing at the door
   - Fix: Send the PDA word, worded for where it is, when go_to_door has failed and is held back, instead of only from the door
113. **[DRV-12](findings/DRV-12-work-held-back-sends-the-body-exploring-and-straight-back.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): While a step of its work is held back the body goes exploring or to other work, and the walk back is let off before the step is, so it walks away and back every few seconds
   - Fix: Offer no idle explore while work is only held back, and hold back any walk to a place where a step has just failed until that step is let off
114. **[ENG-04](findings/ENG-04-door-job-handed-to-an-engineer-is-waited-on-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): A door the Chief Engineer has handed to an engineer is waited on for ever, and security, told "I am sending X", hears nothing more if X never reports
   - Fix: Give each entry of forcing.sent a time limit, and when it passes with no word back tell whoever asked that engineering has not been able to open the room, and drop the entry
115. **[ENG-05](findings/ENG-05-light-the-engine-words-take-do-not-light-and-miss-relight.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The Captain's "light the engine" is read from any line holding those three words, so "do not light the engine" relights it, while "relight the engine" is not read at all
   - Fix: Read the order to light the engine again with a pattern that wants it at the start of a clause and refuses a negation or a question, and accept relight, restart and start up as well
116. **[ENG-08](findings/ENG-08-after-one-shut-off-the-chief-engineer-never-watches-the-crystal-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): After one shut-off the Chief Engineer stops watching the crystal, so an engine lit again by anyone but its own order loses integrity unwatched
   - Fix: Test the integrity floor whenever the reading shows energy in the crystal, shut or not, and clear chief.shut when the engine is heard or read to be lit again
117. **[ENG-09](findings/ENG-09-chief-engineer-waits-in-engineering-for-its-engineer-with-no-time-limit.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): When an order will not go by PDA the Chief Engineer goes to Engineering and waits there for its engineer with no time limit, doing nothing else
   - Fix: Give the look-for-the-engineer wait a time limit, after which the order is sent by PDA again and, for the shut order, the Captain is told the engineer cannot be reached
118. **[ENG-11](findings/ENG-11-with-no-engineer-the-shut-order-is-dropped-and-the-captain-told-it-is-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): With no engineer to give it to, the emitters-off order is dropped without a word, while the Captain is told the emitters are being switched off and every report after says the engine was shut off
   - Fix: When the shut order has nobody to go to, tell the Captain the emitters are still on and nobody is aboard to switch them off, and keep the order open so it goes to the first engineer that turns up
119. **[GAP-23](findings/GAP-23-model-lines-over-200-characters-are-cut-mid-word-by-the-server.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A line the model words that runs past 200 characters is cut mid-word by the server, after the window has checked it holds the words a hearer needs
   - Fix: Trim every say to the last whole sentence that fits in 200 characters in the window, before the needs test, and fall back to the plain line if the trimmed one no longer holds the needed words
120. **[HAND-02](findings/HAND-02-mess-it-could-not-walk-to-is-written-off-for-the-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A mess the body could not walk to once is put with those that will not come off, for the rest of the round, and it says its mop will not shift it
   - Fix: Keep messes it could not get to in a list of their own with the time, try them again after a few minutes, and tell the brain could not get to it apart from would not come off
121. **[HAND-03](findings/HAND-03-asterisk-in-a-line-turns-speech-into-an-emote.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): An asterisk anywhere in a line turns the words before it into an emote, and the crew do not hear them
   - Fix: Take every asterisk out of the text in tool_say before it is said, not only the ones at the start
122. **[HAND-04](findings/HAND-04-pick-up-goes-for-a-thing-in-sight-it-cannot-get-to-every-time.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): Pick up goes for the nearest thing of that name in sight even when it cannot be got to, every time, and never for the closet it knows holds one
   - Fix: Keep a short list of things pick up could not get to, with the time, skip them in tool_pick_up for a few minutes, and fall through to the remembered container
123. **[HAND-05](findings/HAND-05-pick-up-goes-back-to-a-locker-it-found-locked-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A locker found locked or welded on a fetch is still remembered as holding the thing, so every later pick up walks back to it and fails, and the janitor never asks for supplies
   - Fix: In tool_pick_up skip a container whose last look found it shut to the body, and in the window leave a locked container's items out of allKnownItems
124. **[HAND-07](findings/HAND-07-person-inside-a-searched-locker-is-shut-back-in-and-not-reported.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A person found inside a locker it searches tumbles out, is shut back in 0.8 seconds later, and the brain is told only what items were inside
   - Fix: In look_inside and take_from_container note any living mob that came out on opening, leave the container open if one is on its tile, and tell the brain who was inside
125. **[JAN-01](findings/JAN-01-scrub-cut-short-is-taken-as-mess-that-will-not-come-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A scrub cut short, by the body being sent elsewhere, moved or knocked down, is taken as a mess that will not come off
   - Fix: In clean_mess, mark a mess stubborn only if the body stayed on its errand, in reach and fit, and the scrub ran its course, else return a plain could not finish
126. **[JAN-02](findings/JAN-02-mop-taken-as-unable-to-shift-garbage-and-molten-mess.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A wet mop is taken as unable to shift decomposing garbage and a gooey grey mass, which it does shift, so a janitor leaves them or swaps its mop for a rag
   - Fix: In can_clean_mess judge a mop by its cleaner component strength (CLEAN_SCRUB) and is_mopped, not by CLEAN_WASH, and take garbage and gooey grey mass out of SCRUB_KINDS for a body with a mop
127. **[JAN-05](findings/JAN-05-table-it-could-not-reach-is-chosen-again-for-every-thing-tidied.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A table or bin the body could not walk to is marked skipped but never looked at again, so every thing tidied is picked up, carried at it and dropped
   - Fix: Make nearest_surface and nearest_bin skip a place with a fresh tidy_skipped entry, as wants_tidying already does for things
128. **[JAN-09](findings/JAN-09-machine-state-checked-a-second-before-a-toggling-click.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): A pump, filter or emitter is looked at a second before the click that toggles it, so if anyone sets it in that second the body sets it back, an emitter switched off is switched on again
   - Fix: Do the click gap first and look at the machine after it, just before the click, in turn_machine and switch_emitter, and never click a toggle on a machine already as wanted
129. **[JAN-13](findings/JAN-13-mess-cleaned-by-someone-else-turns-room-into-one-beyond-its-mop.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A mess someone else cleaned up, out of the janitor's sight, makes the room one its mop will not shift, and the room is left unvisited with the old mess still on its list
   - Fix: Make workable_mess_places judge a remembered mess by what was seen of it (its kind, kept in the memory entry), not by whether it still exists, so it agrees with mess_places until the body has looked
130. **[JOBS-02](findings/JOBS-02-crate-errand-dropped-at-half-an-hour-while-hauling-or-after-unpacking.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A crate errand still on the go half an hour after the head sent for it is thrown away mid-haul or after unpacking, so the head is never told and the empty crate is never taken back
   - Fix: Give a Task a keepUntil that the give-up rule in syncTasks honours, and have pickups push it on when the crate is put out, when collect_crate succeeds and when the empty is being taken back
131. **[JOBS-05](findings/JOBS-05-everyone-aboard-knows-from-anywhere-which-crates-are-out-in-the-lobby.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Every body aboard is told from anywhere which crates cargo has put out in the lobby and who took them, and a collector sets off for its crate before it has seen it
   - Fix: Only act on a crate being out when the body is in the room the crate is in (brain.location equals the crate's place), and on the server send out crates to non-cargo bodies only when they are in that room
132. **[KNA-02](findings/KNA-02-shut-in-body-leaves-the-door-it-waits-at.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): A body shut in and waiting at the door is sent off to search storage and to walk to rooms it cannot reach
   - Fix: While shut in with no open door in view, offer only steps that keep the body where it is, and make the meeting step wait instead of walking
133. **[KNA-05](findings/KNA-05-thing-handed-over-during-an-errand-is-kept-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A thing pushed into a hand while the body is on any errand is taken for its own and carried for the rest of the shift
   - Fix: During an errand, count a thing as its own only if the errand is one that picks things up and the thing is what it went for, and queue the rest to be put down
134. **[KNA-26](findings/KNA-26-officer-asks-to-be-let-in-only-by-pda-never-to-a-keeper-in-sight.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Shut out, the officer asks to be let in only by PDA, in a fixed order, never to the face of a keeper it can see, and with no PDA it gives up at once
   - Fix: Ask first whichever keeper is in sight, aloud, and fall back to the PDA list only when none is, and with no PDA wait at the door for a keeper to come by
135. **[KNA-31](findings/KNA-31-open-door-rule-misses-locked-hallways-the-case-it-was-built-for.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): The rule against a way in through a locked door that stands open this minute is skipped for hallways, so the officer can still walk into the Service Hallway behind a janitor, the case it was written for
   - Fix: In tool_go_to_door test every route with route_by_open_door, whatever room the door opens from, and in particular treat a hallway with doors of its own as locked by hallway_locked_to
136. **[KNB-09](findings/KNB-09-aloud-heads-ignore-on-my-way-and-reports-by-pda.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): The Quartermaster and the Chief Engineer call absent staff to a meeting by PDA but read neither the On my way back nor a report sent by PDA, and never tell them it is over
   - Fix: Move the reading of On my way and of a report by PDA out of the Head of Personnel's readsMessage into one helper every head calls, and send the meeting-is-over word to anyone who was called by PDA
137. **[KNB-10](findings/KNB-10-technician-answers-orders-spoken-to-nobody-across-the-bay.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician answers an order the Captain spoke to the Quartermaster from seven tiles off, because a line said to nobody passes the not-said-to-someone-else test
   - Fix: Take a spoken order or a come-for-my-crate line only when it was said to this technician, or was said to nobody by someone standing at its counter
138. **[KNB-15](findings/KNB-15-crate-would-not-come-word-is-dropped-when-the-quartermaster-is-not-found.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Word that a crate would not come is dropped without a trace when the Quartermaster is not found, and a technician who cannot reach its office door holds it five minutes for nothing
   - Fix: When tellQuartermaster gives up on a would-not-come word, send the same line to the Quartermaster by PDA and have its readsMessage pass a technician's WONT_COME_WORDS to crateHeldUp
139. **[LIFE-01](findings/LIFE-01-walk-cut-short-by-a-stun-marks-the-room-as-no-way-in.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A walk cut short because the body was knocked down marks the room it was going to as one with no way in, for five minutes
   - Fix: Give a walk that ends because the controller stopped running its own reason, and only mark blocked_places for a walk that found no way or ran out of time
140. **[LIFE-02](findings/LIFE-02-scrub-broken-off-writes-the-mess-off-as-stubborn.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A scrub broken off because the janitor was sent elsewhere, moved or knocked down writes the mess off as one that will not come off
   - Fix: In clean_mess, after the wait, mark a mess stubborn only if the errand is still the same one and the body stayed beside the mess and able to act throughout, else return an interrupted outcome
141. **[LIFE-03](findings/LIFE-03-route-test-ends-by-overriding-a-newer-order.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Explore, force door and go to door test routes in a sleep and then start their walk over whatever the body was told to do meanwhile
   - Fix: Note errand_serial before the route tests and drop the result if it has moved on, and report the body as busy while it tests routes
142. **[LOGA-02](findings/LOGA-02-meeting-closed-on-a-technician-out-of-view-for-three-seconds-who-then-stands-seven-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The Quartermaster closes its meeting the moment a technician it called is out of its view for three seconds, and that technician then stands seven minutes in the bay waiting for it
   - Fix: Before the closing line, wait a short while for anyone invited who has given no report and was in view or said they were coming, and tell anyone invited and unheard by PDA that the meeting is over
143. **[LOGA-07](findings/LOGA-07-model-takes-on-a-call-the-janitor-code-has-just-turned-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): A call the janitor's code has just turned down (needs soap or a rag, and it has neither) is taken on all the same when the model answers work, and the janitor sets off for a locked room it cannot get into
   - Fix: Note the room of a call the janitor turned down, and have takeToldWork refuse a CLEAN task for that room from the model until the janitor holds something that scrubs
144. **[LOGB-03](findings/LOGB-03-door-opened-for-another-janitor-is-booked-to-the-one-named.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A door the server opens for some other janitor is booked by the brain as opened for the one it named, who is then let out of a room they were never in for good
   - Fix: Send back who the door was opened for in the open_door result details and have the brain book that person, not task.item, and never book a let-in for a name the server did not find
145. **[LOGB-04](findings/LOGB-04-quartermaster-answers-one-knock-again-and-again-for-a-minute.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): The Quartermaster answers one knock at its office door again and again for a minute, walking out and back each time
   - Fix: Clear brain.knockAt in syncTasks as soon as the Quartermaster is out of its office after a knock, not only in afterActing where the task it looks for has already been thrown away
146. **[LOGB-05](findings/LOGB-05-shut-in-janitor-learns-the-public-cargo-lobby-is-locked-and-keeps-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A janitor shut in a room learns that the Cargo Lobby and the Cargo Bay each open only from the other, keeps that for good, and makes for the door of the public lobby
   - Fix: Send door_through from go_to_door only when a route to the outer room's own door was found, never from a body that is shut in, and have the brain refuse an entry that makes a loop and forget entries after a while
147. **[LOGB-06](findings/LOGB-06-janitor-at-a-cargo-door-writes-only-to-the-caller-even-in-cuffs.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A janitor waiting at a cargo door writes only to the technician who called it, eight times in thirteen minutes while that technician was in cuffs, and never to the other one
   - Fix: When word to the caller brings nobody, write next to another technician on the PDA list and then the Quartermaster, once each, and do not write again to someone already written to for that door
148. **[MAP-02](findings/MAP-02-department-security-officers-taken-for-cargo-technicians-and-engineers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A security officer posted to Cargo or Engineering is taken for a cargo technician or an engineer, because job titles are matched by a bare word
   - Fix: Match a title against the game's whole job titles (a list per job, alternate titles included) instead of a word inside it, and test the security-officer department titles first
149. **[MAP-04](findings/MAP-04-prisoners-taken-to-the-cargo-checkpoint-cell-on-delta-and-tram.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): On DeltaStation and Tramstation every prisoner is walked to the Cargo Cell at the cargo checkpoint, because cells are tried in order of name and not by where they are
   - Fix: Count as the brig's cells only the timers inside the brig rooms (the area the officer was taught as the brig and its subtypes), and among them try the nearest first, keeping checkpoint and isolation cells for when those are full
150. **[MEM-01](findings/MEM-01-any-word-of-its-name-or-job-anywhere-is-taken-as-said-to-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Any word of an NPC's name or job anywhere in a line is taken as said to it
   - Fix: In saidTo rule 1 use callsOn for the NPC's own name and job, not usesName, and keep usesName only as a tie-break when no one else is called on
151. **[MEM-02](findings/MEM-02-a-note-that-corrects-an-older-one-is-dropped-and-the-old-one-kept.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): A note that corrects an older one is dropped as a copy of it, and the old one is kept
   - Fix: When a new note is the same as an old one, put the new note in the old one's place instead of dropping the new one
152. **[MEM-04](findings/MEM-04-of-two-rooms-named-the-longest-name-wins-not-the-one-meant.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Of two rooms named in one line the longest name is taken, not the one meant, so orders go to the wrong room
   - Fix: In placeNamedIn drop matches that lie inside a longer match, then take the first room named that is not set aside by not, forget, leave or instead of, rather than the longest name
153. **[MEM-06](findings/MEM-06-may-i-come-in-is-taken-as-said-to-anyone-called-may.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): May I come in is taken as said to anyone aboard called May, even when the speaker is alone with the NPC
   - Fix: In callsOn accept a name at the start with no comma after it only for someone in view, and for anyone not in view require the comma or colon
154. **[MEM-07](findings/MEM-07-told-of-a-mess-in-the-room-it-stands-in-but-out-of-sight-it-takes-nothing-on.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Told of a mess in the room it is standing in but cannot see from where it stands, a janitor takes nothing on, even from its head
   - Fix: In takeToldWork take the work in the room it stands in as told work like any other, and let the janitor's look-about rule close it if there is nothing there
155. **[MEM-08](findings/MEM-08-any-mention-of-check-or-look-and-a-room-by-a-superior-is-an-order-to-go-and-look.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Any line from a superior with check, look or see if in it and a room named is an order to drop everything and go and look
   - Fix: Make out a look order by code only when the look word is said to the NPC as a request with the room as its object, and leave everything else to the model's work answer
156. **[MULTI-06](findings/MULTI-06-a-mail-notice-to-a-janitor-counts-as-a-janitor-called-and-holds-the-workmate-back-ten-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Any PDA message a technician sends a janitor, a mail notice among them, counts as the post having called a janitor, and holds its workmate's calls to every mess back for ten minutes
   - Fix: Note a janitor call only for a message that is a call to a mess (have the window say so in the tool call), keep the room it was for, and let a workmate's call hold back only a call to that room
157. **[PARSE-03](findings/PARSE-03-short-known-first-name-with-words-after-it-is-not-found.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant on someone known by a first name of three letters fails if any word follows it, so arrest bob pls is a warrant on bob pls and nobody is arrested
   - Fix: In readWarrant, before closeName, try each leading run of the cut words against known first names and full names exactly, so the first word alone can find its one owner
158. **[PARSE-04](findings/PARSE-04-move-pls-and-excuse-me-do-not-ask-it-to-step-aside.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Move pls, excuse me, coming through and let me pass do not ask a body to step aside, while I moved the bucket out of the way and can you move the crate do
   - Fix: Match ASIDE_WORDS against the whole short line for move, excuse me and coming through, accept u and pls, and refuse out of the way and you move when an object follows or the speaker speaks of themselves
159. **[PARSE-06](findings/PARSE-06-order-paper-and-lightbulbs-name-no-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Order paper, order lightbulbs and order jani supplies name no crate, and are answered I cannot order that
   - Fix: Give every orderable crate words it goes by in CRATE_ASKED_AS, the Bureaucracy Crate paper, pens and stationery, lights lightbulbs, and match the janitor words as word starts
160. **[PARSE-07](findings/PARSE-07-a-stranger-who-calls-the-guard-by-name-is-put-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A stranger who answers the guard by its name, Donna the Quartermaster asked me to come in, is taken to have named the guard as who let them in and is put out at once
   - Fix: In the stranger's answer, skip the guard's name where it is used to address the guard (at the start, or set off by a comma), read job titles and their shorthand as the workmate who holds them, and match a workmate by first name only
161. **[PARSE-08](findings/PARSE-08-im-locked-out-is-read-as-wanting-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): I'm locked out, open the door is read as asking to be let out, and I want to leave, open the door from inside is not read as asking out, so neither door is opened
   - Fix: Decide in or out by where the asker stands when the technician can see them, and otherwise by let me out, leave, get out, done in, never by the bare word out
162. **[PARSE-09](findings/PARSE-09-no-need-to-clean-the-bar-is-an-order-to-clean-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): No need to clean the blood in the bar, I did it, from the Captain or a head is an order to clean the Bar, and the janitor is told it may not say otherwise
   - Fix: In workInWords, for a superior's line, skip a clause that is a question, is negated (no need, don't, do not, never mind), or says the mess is gone (cleaned, gone, fine now, got it), and leave those to the model's work field
163. **[PARSE-14](findings/PARSE-14-josh-reed-come-here-is-taken-by-josh-kim-too.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Josh Reed, come here is taken by Josh Kim as said to him, so a full name used to tell two crew apart does not, and Al, open the door is said to nobody
   - Fix: In saidTo, before rule 1, find the longest known full name the line calls on, and if it is someone else's the line is theirs; and let a first name of one or two letters be called on when it stands at the start or is set off by a comma
164. **[PARSE-15](findings/PARSE-15-meeting-order-words-miss-plain-asks-and-take-questions.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Status report on your department and gather your staff call no meeting, while did you hold a meeting and check the bar, no need for a meeting each call one and drop the order
   - Fix: Refuse MEETING_ORDER_WORDS in a question or after a negation, add the plain asks for a report and for gathering staff, and test it per clause so an order in another clause still stands
165. **[PARSE-16](findings/PARSE-16-quartermaster-hop-janitor-said-first-call-on-nobody.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Quartermaster, order some paper and Janitor, clean the bar call on nobody when anyone else is about, because only crew with a post are known by their job, and HoP, QM, CE, HoS and sec never
   - Fix: Let any crew member be called on by its job title or the usual shorthand for it, in callsOn's strict shapes (at the start, or set off by a comma), longest title first so Engineer is not taken from Chief Engineer
166. **[PARSE-17](findings/PARSE-17-someone-threw-up-in-the-bar-is-put-to-the-group.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Someone threw up in the bar, said to a janitor's face, is taken as put to everyone there, and only the nearest crew member answers, who may not be the janitor
   - Fix: Count someone, somebody, anyone, anybody and everyone as putting a line to the group only when they are the one asked (can someone, does anyone, is anybody, anyone know), not as the subject of the sentence, and test the beside and facing rules before the group words
167. **[PERF-03](findings/PERF-03-every-body-looks-in-the-same-tick.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Every body of a crew spawned together looks round in the same tick each second, so the whole crew's sight work and every sighting it raises land in one tick
   - Fix: Start each body's looping look timer after a random first wait of up to one second, so the crew's looks are spread across the twenty ticks of each second
168. **[QM-04](findings/QM-04-own-crate-lost-is-tried-for-ever-and-blocks-ordering-paper.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): A crate the Quartermaster ordered for itself that is lost before it opens it is tried for the rest of the round, keeps it out of its office, and stops it ever ordering paper again
   - Fix: Mark an own order's crate as done with when it is reported lost or when open_own_crate answers no_such_crate, so the unpack task ends and orderForItself is free again
169. **[QM-05](findings/QM-05-technician-sent-to-a-shut-in-workmate-does-not-go.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): Told that a technician is shut in, the Quartermaster sends another to see to it, and the one sent only takes on the shuttle and the rooms and never goes to the door
   - Fix: Have the technician who hears it is to see to someone shut in note it as a let-out ask for that room, the way a PDA from the shut-in person is noted, so it walks to that door, and let the Quartermaster go itself when no other technician is about
170. **[QM-12](findings/QM-12-lost-crate-reordered-once-per-order-so-a-chain-never-ends.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): A lost crate is meant to be ordered again once, but each reorder is a new order with its own once, so crates that keep being lost are bought again and again
   - Fix: Carry the reorder mark onto the new order (again.reordered = true, or a reorderOf link) so a reorder that is lost in turn is told and written but not bought a third time
171. **[RT-05](findings/RT-05-runtime-inside-an-errand-leaves-the-body-busy-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A runtime error anywhere inside an errand or a storage look leaves the body counted as busy for the rest of the round, and the window never sends it anything again
   - Fix: Wrap do_errand and look_inside in try-catch in their perform_async so a thrown error still closes the errand with a failed result, and give the window a limit on how long it believes a body is walking
172. **[SEC-04](findings/SEC-04-cell-it-cannot-walk-to-is-tried-over-and-over.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A cell the officer cannot walk to, or whose timer will not work, is picked again every time and the other cells are never tried
   - Fix: Call cell_refuses for the cell in jail_cell whenever a jail errand ends in no_way or timer, including the walk that never reached the timer
