173. **[SEC-07](findings/SEC-07-cuff-tries-burned-then-free-to-go-in-cuffs.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A crew member left in cuffs burns its three tries in three seconds, is told it is free to go, and works the rest of the shift in handcuffs
   - Fix: Count a try only when the game let one start, never end custody while the cuffs are on, and have the body ask to have them taken off when its tries are spent
174. **[SEC-15](findings/SEC-15-attacker-looked-for-by-name-so-the-baton-can-go-to-someone-else.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Whoever attacked the officer is looked for by name and not by the handle the server gave, so with two masked Unknowns, or two of one name, the baton goes to whichever is first in view
   - Fix: Find the attacker in peopleInView by beat.attacker.handle first and by name only when no handle came, and send the stop to that handle
175. **[SECT-04](findings/SECT-04-taking-back-a-warrant-works-in-one-word-order-only.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A head can take back its warrant only with the verb before the word warrant, and neither the LLM reader nor the not-followed line knows taking back exists
   - Fix: Read cancel words on either side of warrant and with their endings, give the LLM reader a withdraw kind, and put the take-back wording in the not-followed line
176. **[SECT-05](findings/SECT-05-twenty-minutes-or-an-hour-is-read-as-the-reason.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A time in words past fifteen, or given as half an hour or an hour, is read as the reason and the warrant gets five minutes
   - Fix: Read the tens as words and half an hour or an hour as 30 and 60, then cap at the most a cell allows as digits are capped now
177. **[SECT-08](findings/SECT-08-sent-in-by-the-captain-or-its-own-head-is-no-answer-and-is-put-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone in a locked room who answers that the Captain or their own head sent them is taken to have given no answer, and is walked out
   - Fix: Let the answer name anyone the guard knows to be the Captain or a head as well as a workmate, ask them if they are in sight, and take the word otherwise, or ask the owner which
178. **[SECT-09](findings/SECT-09-a-yes-with-no-problem-or-not-in-it-is-read-as-a-no.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A workmate's yes that has no or not anywhere in it, such as Yes I asked him in, no problem, is read as a no and the visitor is walked out
   - Fix: Read yes or no from how the answer begins, and only fall back to looking through the whole line when it begins with neither
179. **[SECT-12](findings/SECT-12-any-number-of-minutes-after-a-warrant-changes-its-time.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Any line from the Captain in the five minutes after a warrant that has it or him and a number of minutes in it changes the warrant's time
   - Fix: Read a time as a term only with a holding verb before it (keep, hold, lock, jail, give him, make it) and the minutes as its object
180. **[SECT-15](findings/SECT-15-sighting-by-first-name-is-told-there-is-no-warrant.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Word that a wanted person is somewhere, given by first name or run together, is answered there is no warrant on them, though there is
   - Fix: Find the wanted name in a sighting the way a pardon finds it, with closeIn and a first name that only one wanted person has, before saying there is no warrant
181. **[SECT-16](findings/SECT-16-first-name-two-people-share-is-a-warrant-on-both.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant by a first name two crew share is taken without asking which, and then names both of them
   - Fix: When the name read is a first name that two or more known people have, take no warrant and ask which, naming both in full
182. **[SECT-21](findings/SECT-21-wanted-on-the-bridge-and-wasted-are-read-as-warrants.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Walker is wanted on the bridge, Dana is wasted and put Dana up for the night shift are each read as a warrant, the spelling mender making wanted out of wasted and waited
   - Fix: Take is wanted as a warrant only when nothing but a reason follows it, never with a place after it, keep the mender off words that are real words, and drop up from the lock-around pattern unless the verb is lock
183. **[SENSE-01](findings/SENSE-01-throw-out-drags-the-down-and-takes-people-from-others-grip.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The keeper of a room drags out a stranger who is out cold, dead or in cuffs, and pulls someone out of another person's grip, the Captain's included
   - Fix: In why_not_put_out refuse when the person is down, cuffed, or already pulled by someone else, and in syncGuarding do not count unanswered asks of a person who is down
184. **[SENSE-05](findings/SENSE-05-walk-out-door-chosen-without-looking-at-its-power.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The door to walk a stranger out by is picked without looking at whether it has power, so once the station power fails the walk out makes for a door that will not open
   - Fix: In spot_outside_post skip a door that has no power or is shut and electrified, the same test the door tool uses in hold_door_for
185. **[SENSE-07](findings/SENSE-07-walk-out-cut-short-by-a-new-walk-drags-the-stranger-along.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A walk out by the arm that is cut short by a new order drags the stranger along on the new walk, and a crew stranger stays held for forty seconds though nobody holds it
   - Fix: Have start_walk and start_errand call put_out when they replace a throw_out walk, and make in_hand end as soon as the body is no longer pulled by the one who took hold of it
186. **[SENSE-10](findings/SENSE-10-pda-message-lost-while-in-a-locker-or-the-pipes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A PDA message that comes while the body is in a locker, a crate, the disposal pipes or a mech is thrown away, because the test for the PDA being on it stops at the locker
   - Fix: In on_pda_message test that the PDA is somewhere inside the body by walking up its loc to the body, not that the topmost thing on the turf is the body
187. **[SIM-01](findings/SIM-01-stand-in-pda-always-sends-to-anyone.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The simulator's PDA always sends, to any name at all, so no scenario can reach a message that fails
   - Fix: Make the stand-in message case look the name up in the sender's pda_people, fail with the server's words when it is not there, and add a PDA-down switch that answers with the would-not-send words
188. **[SIM-02](findings/SIM-02-crash-in-reply-handling-passes-as-a-dead-model.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): A crash in the window code after the model answers is caught as a dead model, and the simulator still says all passed
   - Fix: Have the stand-in act() count every brain_log decision whose error is not the stand-in's own dead-model words, print them, and fail the run if there are any
189. **[SUP-03](findings/SUP-03-take-in-hand-drops-the-order-book-on-the-floor.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): With both hands full the Quartermaster drops its clipboard, sheet or pen on the floor when it only meant to check for a free hand
   - Fix: Make take_in_hand look for an empty hand first and return FALSE without touching the thing when there is none
190. **[SUP-07](findings/SUP-07-any-pda-message-to-a-person-wipes-the-notice-owed-them.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Any PDA message to a person strikes off the first crate notice owed to them, so a note about mail cancels the word that their order has come in
   - Fix: Have the window say which notice a message is about and have tool_message strike off only a notice of that kind
191. **[SUP-08](findings/SUP-08-pda-message-text-is-sent-as-raw-html.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A crew NPC's PDA message skips the game's cleaning, so its text reaches the other person's chat as raw HTML
   - Fix: Run the text through the messenger's own sanitize_pda_message before it is sent or kept for resending
192. **[SUP-11](findings/SUP-11-budget-check-ignores-the-cart-and-an-unpaid-order-flies-the-shuttle-in-circles.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): The budget check before an order leaves out what is already in the cart, and an order the shuttle cannot pay for flies the shuttle to and fro for six minutes and is then called held up
   - Fix: Count the cost of every order already in SSshuttle.shopping_list against the budget in tool_order, and in supply_run_step tell an order that came back unbought for want of money from one held up, and say so
193. **[SUP-13](findings/SUP-13-crate-of-another-order-taken-by-its-name.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): When one of an order's crates did not come, order_arrived takes another order's crate of the same kind for it by its name, and that order's technician then cannot find its own
   - Fix: In the by-name pass of order_arrived skip any crate that still has a manifest or whose name ends in another order's number, and read the number from the name when the manifest is gone
194. **[TRA-01](findings/TRA-01-one-crate-counted-for-three-janitors-holds-two-tools.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): The head orders one crate for every three janitors short, but a crate of janitorial supplies holds only two things a janitor counts as proper tools
   - Fix: Count a Janitorial Supplies Crate as good for two janitors (its mop and its spray cleaner), not three, and give the simulator's crate the rag the real one has
195. **[TRA-03](findings/TRA-03-no-such-crate-heard-ends-every-collecting-errand-whatever-the-number.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Any line from cargo about a lost crate or a wrong number ends every crate errand a collector has asked for in the last minute, whatever crate it was about
   - Fix: In pickupsOverhear act only on a line that names the task's own crate number, or on a numberless no-such-crate line said to this body by name or beside it
196. **[TRA-06](findings/TRA-06-janitor-asks-the-captain-for-supplies-instead-of-its-head.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A janitor short of supplies with the Captain in sight asks the Captain to their face, not its head, and then waits eight minutes before it tells its head
   - Fix: In needStep ask the head of the body's own department, in view or by PDA, and treat the Captain as the one to ask only when the department has no head aboard
197. **[TRA-08](findings/TRA-08-second-asker-gets-a-new-crate-though-the-one-coming-has-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Someone who asks while an order is on its way gets a crate of their own ordered, though the crate coming holds enough for them, and is then served from the first crate anyway
   - Fix: Count an order in hand as good for count times PER_CRATE people and put a later asker on it while there is room, ordering afresh only for those it cannot cover
198. **[TRB-06](findings/TRB-06-someone-out-of-their-cell-early-is-not-seen-by-the-officer-until-the-term-ends.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone who gets out of their cell before their time, let out by a player or breaking out, is not seen by the officer until the term would have ended, even on a new warrant
   - Fix: In inCells count a name from beat.jailed only while that person is not in view outside a running cell, and drop the jailed and held entries when they are seen out
199. **[TRB-08](findings/TRB-08-a-cell-whose-door-is-smashed-is-still-picked-and-the-prisoner-reported-jailed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A cell whose glass door has been smashed is still picked first, the prisoner is shut in a cell that cannot shut, and is reported jailed
   - Fix: In free_cell pass over a cell whose door() is null or broken, and in put_in_cell answer no_way with a reason when the door is gone, calling cell_refuses
200. **[TRB-09](findings/TRB-09-why-a-warrant-cannot-be-served-is-told-once-a-round-per-person-never-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Why a warrant cannot be served is told once a round for each person, so on a second warrant on the same person nobody hears it and engineering is never asked to force the door again
   - Fix: Clear the cannotTold keys for a name when its warrant leaves beat.warrants (jailed, dropped, handed back), and let a key be told again after a few minutes while the warrant still stands
201. **[TRC-03](findings/TRC-03-any-pda-naming-a-meeting-in-a-room-is-a-call-to-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Any PDA message from the Captain or a head with meeting in the and a room in it is taken as a call to a meeting there, and the NPC drops its work and waits in that room seven minutes
   - Fix: In readSummons take a call only in the words a head calls by (Staff meeting in the X now) and take meeting is over only from a summons already standing from that sender
202. **[TRUST-07](findings/TRUST-07-quartermaster-takes-any-cargo-workers-word-that-an-order-failed-or-a-crate-is-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): The Quartermaster takes "order N did not go through" and "crate N is lost" from anyone in a cargo job, and places the order again or buys the crate again
   - Fix: Take did-not-go-through only from the technician the order was given to, and lost only for a crate cargo is holding, from the technician who reports it, before ordering it again
203. **[TRUST-08](findings/TRUST-08-pda-word-goes-to-the-first-pda-with-that-name.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A PDA message the crew send by name goes to the first PDA with that name, so a second PDA renamed to a head's name takes all the head's word
   - Fix: Have messenger_named pick, among the PDAs aboard with that name, the one whose job the window expects, and refuse with a reason when two fit
204. **[ARR-07](findings/ARR-07-someone-in-sight-in-its-own-room-it-cannot-walk-to-is-tried-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): Someone in sight in the officer's own room whom it cannot walk to is told and tried for ever, and nobody hears why
   - Fix: Count a no_way with nowhere to ask as a failed try, so that it rests after three and reports that it cannot get to them
205. **[ARR-08](findings/ARR-08-older-warrant-coming-into-sight-breaks-off-an-arrest-under-way.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): With two warrants, the person on the older one coming into sight breaks off an arrest of the other that is under way
   - Fix: In orderToDrop do not drop a step of one emergency task for another emergency task, and have serveStep make the other warrant wait while an arrest is in hand
206. **[ARR-13](findings/ARR-13-warrant-handed-back-mid-arrest-leaves-the-head-of-security-holding-them.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A warrant the Head of Security hands back while its own arrest is under way leaves it holding the prisoner on no warrant, and the officer leaves them to it
   - Fix: In handBack keep a warrant whose arrest is under way as well as one whose person is held, and in beatAfterActing take back a warrant the desk still lists when an arrest comes back with the cuffs on
207. **[ARR-15](findings/ARR-15-room-with-no-door-locked-to-it-is-taken-for-one-to-be-let-into.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A room with no door locked to security, that it could not walk into for fire doors or a breach, is asked of the Captain and then forced open by engineering
   - Fix: Treat an empty keepers answer from the server as no locked door, and in that case do not open shutOut but count a try and say what is in the way
208. **[ARR-17](findings/ARR-17-let-go-of-dan-frees-jordan-whom-it-has-by-the-arm.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): Told to let go of someone by a short name, security frees whoever it has by the arm if that name is anywhere inside theirs
   - Fix: Match names in tool_free and set_free word by word, as sameName does in the window, not with findtext
209. **[BRAIN-11](findings/BRAIN-11-order-reader-samples-at-talk-temperature-and-minutes-go-unchecked.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The reader of last resort for orders is sampled at the talking temperature, so one message can read as a warrant one time and neither the next, and its minutes are never checked against the message
   - Fix: Give callOllama a temperature argument and pass 0 for readOrder, and take the minutes only when a number of minutes is written in the message
210. **[CARGO-06](findings/CARGO-06-order-taken-from-a-line-said-by-someone-who-is-no-head.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): With a head among those who just spoke, an order can be taken from a line someone else said, and is placed for them
   - Fix: In agrees, pass only a line whose speaker is in view and may order (a head or the Captain, and with a Quartermaster aboard the head who said it did not answer), and said to this technician
211. **[CARGO-10](findings/CARGO-10-any-line-with-the-word-door-wipes-a-standing-ask.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): Anyone saying the word door in a technician's hearing, a workmate included, replaces the ask for a door it was about to answer
   - Fix: Keep a standing ask that may be let through unless the new one may be too, and do not take the word door from cargo staff as an ask
212. **[CORE-06](findings/CORE-06-careful-step-blocks-moves-the-body-did-not-make.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): The careful step near slippery things blocks every move of the body, including being pulled, so a crew member dragged across a peel or soap slips out of the grip
   - Fix: In mind_its_step, only slow down for a step the body takes itself, and return at once when the move comes from a pull, a throw or being carried
213. **[DESK-09](findings/DESK-09-mop-put-down-to-take-up-a-rag-is-forgotten-and-a-new-one-asked-for.md)** (not checked, finder likely, janitor): A janitor that put its mop and bucket down to scrub with a rag forgets where they are, and asks its head for something better than a rag
   - Fix: Remember the room it put its mop and bucket down in, and in supplyStep go back there for them before searching or asking its head
214. **[DESK-10](findings/DESK-10-mop-and-soap-in-hand-with-a-bucket-known-it-never-sets-off-for-a-mess.md)** (not checked, finder likely, janitor): With a mop in one hand and soap or a spray in the other, a janitor that knows of a bucket tries to pick it up before every mess elsewhere, fails, and never sets off
   - Fix: Take the go-for-a-bucket step only when a hand is free or the other hand holds a rag, and after a failed try at the bucket stop offering it for that task
215. **[DOOR-03](findings/DOOR-03-shut-in-test-counts-locked-rooms-and-no-rooms.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): The test for being shut in can say yes in a hallway, and says yes when it has tested nothing
   - Fix: In check_shut_in leave out rooms locked to the body, never conclude shut in from zero routes tested or in a hallway, and first ask whether any door of the room it stands in opens to it
216. **[DOOR-06](findings/DOOR-06-door-out-chosen-without-testing-the-way-to-it.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): The door out of a room is chosen without testing that the body can walk to it, so it makes for the same unreachable door every time
   - Fix: Test a route to the inside tile for a door out as is done for a door in, and remember a door that a walk failed to reach so the next call passes it over
217. **[DOOR-15](findings/DOOR-15-electrified-door-shocks-the-chief-engineer-and-is-reported-as-a-wire-fault.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): An electrified door shocks a body without insulated gloves, the Chief Engineer always, as it goes for the wires, and the brain is told only that a wire would not pulse, so it goes back for a second shock
   - Fix: Watch for the body being shocked at the door (COMSIG_LIVING_ELECTROCUTE_ACT) and answer reason electrified, which forcing.ts takes as final, and check for insulated gloves before going into the wires of a door that has shocked it
218. **[HEAD-03](findings/HEAD-03-two-staff-with-one-first-name-break-the-meeting.md)** (not checked, finder likely, head): Two staff with the same first name both answer one call-on, the second is never given a turn, and the head repeats the call and then walks off with the meeting unclosed
   - Fix: Call on someone by full name when another of those present shares the first name, and have meetingSaid prefer a present person without a turn yet when it matches the call to a name
219. **[HEAD-04](findings/HEAD-04-any-staff-line-with-out-of-or-i-need-is-an-order.md)** (not checked, finder likely, head): Anything a janitor says near the Head of Personnel with "I need", "out of" or "supplies" in it is noted as asking for supplies, and a crate is ordered
   - Fix: Take an ask only from the set asking line or a line that says I need something for my work, and take a report only from the person whose turn it is, or one that begins with the head's first name and reads as a report
220. **[HEAD-06](findings/HEAD-06-head-that-cannot-reach-the-room-keeps-staff-waiting-seven-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder likely, head): A head that is shut in, or cannot get to the meeting room, still calls its meeting and keeps all its staff standing there for seven minutes
   - Fix: Call no meeting while the head is shut in, and once the gathering wait has run out with the head still not in place, end the meeting so its staff are told by PDA and send their reports
221. **[HEAD-07](findings/HEAD-07-a-name-and-report-in-any-head-line-is-a-call-on.md)** (not checked, finder likely, head): Any line from its head with a staff member's first name and the word report in it makes that one give its report, and the head then calls on it again and stands 45 seconds waiting for a report already given
   - Fix: Have staff take only "first name, your report" as a call-on, have nextTurn skip anyone whose report is already in, and forbid other names in the call-on line through its needs pattern
222. **[HEAD-10](findings/HEAD-10-no-meeting-room-found-falls-back-to-the-bar-staff-cannot-enter.md)** (not checked, finder likely, head): When the server finds no meeting room on the Head of Personnel's own deck, the window falls back to the Bar, which the server's own comment says the staff cannot get into
   - Fix: Have the server look for a meeting room on every station deck, nearest first, and in the window drop the Bar fallback so a head with no room tells the Captain once and holds no meeting
223. **[HOLE-18](findings/HOLE-18-a-hand-that-is-lost-or-disabled-is-counted-as-free.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): A hand that is lost or disabled is counted as a free hand, so a one-handed body walks to every thing it is sent for and fails to pick it up, for good
   - Fix: Count a hand as free only when has_hand_for_held_index says the body has a working hand there, in one helper used by every free-hand test, and tell the brain when a hand stops working
224. **[JOBS-04](findings/JOBS-04-freight-step-that-keeps-failing-keeps-the-technician-busy-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): A freight step that cannot be done, such as mail with the bag full, is never set aside, so the technician counts as busy with freight for good and never tidies or looks round again
   - Fix: Pass ok and the reason to afterFreight, block a freight task whose step failed for a few minutes with the reason (retryAt as pickups does), and let SEND go while the mail task is blocked
225. **[JOBS-06](findings/JOBS-06-one-failed-step-aside-shuts-out-every-later-ask-for-up-to-two-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder likely, driver): One step aside that finds nowhere to go puts every later ask to step aside off for 20 seconds to 2 minutes, and a busy body asked meanwhile has its own work sent again
   - Fix: Key the aside step by the asking (ASIDE_STEP_KEY plus asked.at) so each new ask gets a try, and only let dropToMove break into busy work when that aside step is not in back-off
226. **[KNA-06](findings/KNA-06-officer-stops-mid-arrest-to-greet-strangers.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): An officer in the middle of an arrest stops to greet people it has not met
   - Fix: In shouldWake, do not wake the voice for a first meeting while the job says the body cannot leave what it is doing
227. **[KNA-30](findings/KNA-30-kit-drawn-by-clicking-it-inside-a-shut-belt-or-bag.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): Baton, cuffs and an engineer's tools are drawn by clicking them where they lie inside a belt or bag that was never opened, which a player cannot click
   - Fix: In draw_item, when the thing is inside a storage that is not open to the body, click that storage first to open it, then click the thing
228. **[KNB-03](findings/KNB-03-walks-planned-through-the-locked-lobby-airlock.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): A body with no cargo access is given a route through the shut Cargo Bay lobby airlock and walks at it for ten seconds, 51 times in the logs
   - Fix: Look over each planned route in route_planned and end the walk at once, naming the door, when it runs through a shut airlock the body's ID does not open
229. **[KNB-14](findings/KNB-14-walks-tried-while-shut-in-write-off-the-room-it-was-going-to.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): Walks tried while the body is shut in where it stands are counted against the room it was going to, so twice shut in writes that room off for fifteen minutes
   - Fix: In walk_finished do not mark blocked_places or blocked_tries for the goal when the walk failed because the body is shut in where it stands, and clear what was marked while shut in once it is out
230. **[LOGA-04](findings/LOGA-04-a-knock-a-workmate-answered-is-answered-again-a-minute-later-and-a-working-janitor-is-let-out.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): A knock that one technician has answered stays live for the other for a minute, so when the janitor is let back in it is let out again unasked and its scrub is cut short
   - Fix: In doorSought take a knock from inside only if it came after the knocker was last let into that room, and drop a knock once anyone has let that person through that room's door
231. **[LOGA-05](findings/LOGA-05-janitor-holding-two-rags-can-never-take-up-the-mop-and-walks-to-and-fro-for-six-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): A janitor holding two rags can never take up the mop its head ordered for it, and walks to and fro between the closet and elsewhere for six minutes
   - Fix: Count a second of the same tool, and a rag beside anything better, as spare in free_a_hand, and in supplyStep put a rag down before going for a mop or a spray when both hands are full
232. **[LOGA-06](findings/LOGA-06-quartermaster-calls-its-meeting-from-the-lobby-and-closes-it-before-the-first-report.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): The Quartermaster walks out of its meeting room to call a technician, begins the meeting from the lobby, and closes it before the first report, telling the Captain 0 of 2 there
   - Fix: Record the turn of whoever is named in the call-on line among all staff, not only those in view that instant, and close a begun meeting for want of anyone in view only after a short grace with the head in the room
233. **[MAP-06](findings/MAP-06-quartermaster-and-technicians-can-be-given-different-cargo-rooms.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): The technicians' post and the room the Quartermaster looks for them in are each the supply console nearest that body at spawn, so on a map with consoles in two cargo rooms they can differ
   - Fix: Choose the cargo post once for the station (the cargo-area supply console in the room with the most cargo floor, or the one nearest the counter room), keep it in a global, and give the same room to every technician and to the Quartermaster
234. **[MAP-11](findings/MAP-11-a-hole-in-the-floor-counts-as-a-safe-spot-to-stand.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): A hole down to the floor below counts as a safe spot to stand, so on multi-floor maps a room's spot, its middle or a spawn tile can be open space, which no walk reaches and a body made there falls through
   - Fix: Make crew_npc_safe_turf refuse any tile the body could fall through, using the turf's own can_cross_safely, so every spot picker leaves holes out
235. **[MEM-11](findings/MEM-11-work-blocked-over-thirty-minutes-is-dropped-the-moment-it-can-go-on.md)** (not checked, finder likely, memory): Work blocked for over thirty minutes never lapses while blocked, and is dropped the instant it can go on again
   - Fix: Count a task's age for giving up from when it last became open, not from when it was made, and give blocked work a limit of its own
236. **[MULTI-02](findings/MULTI-02-order-docks-while-its-orderer-is-out-and-a-workmate-sends-the-shuttle-back.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): An order that docks while the technician who placed it is out of the bay is unloaded as plain freight by its workmate, the shuttle is sent back and called home again for nothing, and after two misses the order is given up with its crate sitting in the bay
   - Fix: Once the order has left the shopping list and the shuttle has docked home with it, stop moving the shuttle and stop the timeout, and let order_arrived find the crates in the bay whenever the orderer is next there
237. **[MULTI-03](findings/MULTI-03-workmate-whose-card-is-gone-owns-up-to-trespass-and-is-walked-out-of-its-own-post.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): A technician whose ID card has been taken is questioned by its own workmate, answers that nobody sent for it, and is walked out of its own post and locked out for the round
   - Fix: Never open a stranger record on someone in brain.workmates, and have explainStep answer that it works here when the room is its own post
238. **[MULTI-04](findings/MULTI-04-locker-a-workmate-has-open-is-remembered-as-empty-for-five-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): A locker that a workmate has open at that moment is taken for empty, and what it holds is struck from memory for five minutes, so janitors who search one closet together forget its mop and bucket
   - Fix: Read what lies on the tile of a locker found open as its contents, and never overwrite a container's memory from an open look, only add to it
239. **[MULTI-07](findings/MULTI-07-crate-sent-to-a-second-collector-is-fought-over-by-both.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): A crate the head sends a second collector for is gone after by both, and at the crate each pulls it out of the other's hands and wipes the other's claim on it
   - Fix: Set collected_by when tool_collect starts the errand, refuse haul_collected and haul_released when someone else has the crate in hand, clear collected_by on failure only if it is still this body's, and have the head stand the first collector down
240. **[PERF-06](findings/PERF-06-mess-memory-fills-at-300-and-then-sees-no-new-mess.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): A body's mess memory stops taking new messes at 300 and keeps the dead ones for good, so after a tour of maintenance it never notes a new mess, and every look searches its sight once for each dead one
   - Fix: Drop the dead entries in a cheap pass, make room at the cap by forgetting the oldest entry outside the work area, and test sight with a turf set built once per look
241. **[RT-02](findings/RT-02-errand-target-deleted-on-the-way-never-reported.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): An errand whose target is deleted while the body is still walking to it ends without a word to the brain
   - Fix: Override sig_remove_from_blackboard on the crew controller so that a lost errand or storage target is closed off and reported a moment later
242. **[SEC-05](findings/SEC-05-stale-jailed-list-opens-cell-on-someone-else.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): Letting someone go by name can open a cell that now holds somebody else
   - Fix: At the timer, stop it only if someone of that name is standing in the cell, forget a jailed entry that is no longer true, and look for the person in sight before going by memory
243. **[SECT-13](findings/SECT-13-trespass-warrant-on-unknown-names-everyone-with-a-hidden-face.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A masked trespasser shows as Unknown, its head declares a warrant on Unknown, and the officer then arrests anyone whose face is hidden
   - Fix: Refuse a warrant on the name Unknown, and have whoever could not put an Unknown out tell their head what they saw instead of a name
244. **[SENSE-11](findings/SENSE-11-emergency-access-makes-everyone-belong-in-every-post.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): Once emergency maintenance access is on, or the AI opens a door's emergency access, everyone belongs in every post that has such a door, and no stranger is ever questioned there
   - Fix: In belongs_in_post test the person's access against the door's own requirements (check_access_list on their access) instead of door.allowed, so an emergency-open door is not taken for a right to be there
245. **[SUP-04](findings/SUP-04-marked-squares-by-doors-and-on-conveyors.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): Any painted box on the bay floor is taken for a crate square, with no look at doors or conveyors, so on some maps crates are stood on the loading conveyor by the dock doors
   - Fix: Leave out of crew_npc_marked_squares any painted tile that has a conveyor on it or a door within one tile
246. **[SUP-05](findings/SUP-05-shuttle-leaves-with-a-full-crate-a-workmate-has-claimed.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): The shuttle is sent away, and its load sold, while a full crate a workmate has set off for is still aboard
   - Fix: Decide whether the shuttle may leave from every full crate aboard, not only from those no workmate has claimed
247. **[SUP-06](findings/SUP-06-haul-broken-off-by-a-new-order-never-lets-go.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): A body sent somewhere else in the middle of a haul keeps dragging the crate, and a crate being collected stays "being taken away" for good
   - Fix: Have start_walk and start_errand end a haul they replace - let go, clear collected_by, tell the brain - and let a collected_by claim lapse when nobody is pulling the crate
248. **[TRB-05](findings/TRB-05-wanted-person-sitting-in-a-chair-is-cuffed-and-left-in-it.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): Someone wanted who is sitting in a chair or lying in a bed is cuffed, the walk to the brig leaves them behind, and they are reported lost, sat in cuffs where nobody will report them
   - Fix: In hold_arrested unbuckle a buckled prisoner by a click on what they are buckled to, as a player does, before the hold is taken, and answer no_hold if they are still buckled
249. **[TRB-07](findings/TRB-07-crew-prisoner-is-told-it-is-free-the-moment-its-cuffs-come-off-in-the-cell.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A crew prisoner is set free the moment its cuffs come off inside the cell, before the officer is out and the timer started, because the arrest grace is counted from the start of the arrest
   - Fix: In custody_tick leave a crew prisoner held while the body that arrested it is next to it or the cell is being shut, or have put_in_cell call put_in_custody before it takes the cuffs off
250. **[TRUST-01](findings/TRUST-01-janitor-leads-anyone-into-rooms-locked-to-them.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): A janitor asked the way leads anyone, by its own ID, into the Custodial Closet or the maintenance tunnels
   - Fix: Leave out of the lead offer every room that is locked to the asker, which the server already knows as closed rooms and from whether the asker belongs there

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 57

251. **[ARR-01](findings/ARR-01-arrest-tries-held-back-by-driver-up-to-two-minutes.md)** (confirmed, security): Each failed try at an arrest is held back longer by the driver, up to two minutes, while the officer stands beside them
   - Fix: Number each try at an arrest as the tries at a cell are numbered, and say the arrest line again only when toldAt is null
252. **[CARGO-04](findings/CARGO-04-server-refuses-to-open-the-door-for-security.md)** (confirmed, doors): A technician goes to let security in and the server refuses, because open_door lets in nobody but a janitor with a mess to clean
   - Fix: Let tool_open_door (and the simulator's copy of it) open for someone in security who is at the door, and give doorCue words for security that do not talk of a mess
253. **[ENG-03](findings/ENG-03-emitters-off-order-goes-to-whichever-engineer-is-first-on-the-pda.md)** (confirmed, engineering): The emitters-off order, and every other engineering order, goes to whichever engineer is first in sight or on the PDA list, a player or a dead one included, not to the one that lit the engine
   - Fix: Have the Chief Engineer remember which engineer took the engine (and each door job) and give later orders to that one, and fall back to another only after the first has not answered twice, preferring one that has spoken the crew's set words before
254. **[HEAD-01](findings/HEAD-01-empty-cargo-counter-stops-every-later-meeting.md)** (confirmed, head): An order the Head of Personnel cannot get anyone at the counter to take stops every later staff meeting, the Captain's own included
   - Fix: Hold meetings back only while the head is at the counter waiting for an answer (in syncMeeting and in toSee), park an order nobody at the counter takes until after the next meeting and tell the Captain once, and pass over a technician who is down
255. **[HEAD-02](findings/HEAD-02-lost-crate-leaves-the-asker-never-ordered-for-again.md)** (confirmed, head): A crate that is lost, or never unpacked, leaves whoever asked for it noted as ordered for good, so the Head of Personnel never orders for them again
   - Fix: Read Lost at cargo in the head's readsMessage, drop that crate's pickup and set its askers back to not ordered unless cargo is reordering it, drop the pickup on the no-such-crate word, and give an ordered and untold ask an age limit after which it is dropped
256. **[HEAD-05](findings/HEAD-05-order-to-quartermaster-retried-for-ever-when-pda-will-not-send.md)** (confirmed, head): When its PDA will not send, the Head of Personnel's order to the Quartermaster is tried again for ever and never taken to the counter, and no staff meeting is held meanwhile
   - Fix: Note the first try to send the order whether or not it went, stop offering the same message, take a Noted that comes after the server resends it, and go to the counter once the server has stopped resending (about nine minutes)
257. **[ARR-04](findings/ARR-04-no-power-in-the-brig-reads-as-every-cell-in-use.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): With the brig's power out every cell reads as in use, and the officer stands where it made the arrest holding its prisoner, telling nobody
   - Fix: Have tool_jail say no_power apart from no_cell, walk the prisoner to the brig to wait, and tell whoever keeps the list once
258. **[ASYNC-02](findings/ASYNC-02-result-of-the-llms-own-step-taken-for-the-drivers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The answer to a step the LLM took is read as the answer to the driver's step, because answers are matched by tool name only
   - Fix: Send a call number with every tool call, have the server put it on the action_result, and match noteResult on it, or at the least drop lastAct when the LLM sends a call of the same tool
259. **[BRAIN-02](findings/BRAIN-02-hung-model-freezes-every-body-with-a-line-to-say.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A model that hangs, not one that is down, freezes each body with a line to say for 60 seconds times its place in the queue
   - Fix: Give a line the work calls for its own short wait, after which the plain line is said without the model, and give talk calls a shorter time limit
260. **[BRAIN-04](findings/BRAIN-04-line-the-server-refused-is-counted-as-said.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A line the server refuses or throws away is counted as said, and the work goes on as if it had been heard
   - Fix: Read the server's refusal of a say in ingest and say the line again once, and keep the window's own count of tool calls so the server's limit is never reached
261. **[CARGO-18](findings/CARGO-18-sent-to-see-to-a-crate-that-would-not-go-out-to-the-lobby-it-does-nothing.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician the Quartermaster sends to see to a crate that would not go out to the lobby is given nothing to do about it, and the one who failed tries again alone
   - Fix: When the see-to line names a held crate that would not go out to the lobby, have the technician sent take a hand-over task for that number, and have the one who failed drop its own
262. **[CHEAT-04](findings/CHEAT-04-arrest-told-to-prisoner-by-a-call-and-officer-knows-who-is-an-npc.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A crew prisoner is told it is being arrested by a direct call before anything is said or done, and the officer treats it apart because it knows it is an NPC
   - Fix: Let the prisoner learn of its arrest from the words it hears and the cuffs and hand it feels, and have the officer judge who stood for it by what they did, not by whether they have a crew controller
263. **[CHEAT-05](findings/CHEAT-05-cargo-sees-inside-shut-crates.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Cargo staff know what is inside every shut crate, which is empty, which holds mail, and what aboard the shuttle bars it, without opening anything
   - Fix: Know a crate's contents only from having opened it or seen it open, keep that on the controller, and treat a shut crate never looked into as full
264. **[CHEAT-06](findings/CHEAT-06-cargo-knows-shuttle-bay-and-held-crates-from-anywhere.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Cargo staff are told whether the shuttle has docked, what is waiting in the bay and the lobby, and where each held crate is, wherever they are standing
   - Fix: Fill freight, tidy and held from what the body last saw, refreshed only while it is in the bay or lobby or can see the place, and keep the last sight with its time
265. **[CHEAT-11](findings/CHEAT-11-air-in-rooms-out-of-sight-is-known.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A body knows the air pressure on tiles it cannot see, behind shut doors and in rooms it has never entered, and steers by it
   - Fix: Test the air only on tiles the body stands on or can see, and judge unseen rooms by what shows from outside - shut fire doors, a door's pressure warning, an alarm in view
266. **[CHEAT-12](findings/CHEAT-12-crate-order-numbers-read-off-manifests-nobody-tore-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): When the shuttle docks, the technician knows which crate is which order by reading the number off every attached manifest, aboard and in the bay, without touching one
   - Fix: Learn a crate's number by tearing its manifest off with a click and reading it, one crate at a time as each is unloaded, and only then hold and label it
267. **[CHEAT-15](findings/CHEAT-15-crew-see-everything-in-pitch-darkness.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Crew bodies see people, messes and things in pitch darkness, because view() in this codebase ignores light and nothing else checks it
   - Fix: Filter what look_around and the other view() calls return by the light on each tile (turf.get_lumcount against LIGHTING_TILE_IS_DARK), keeping the tiles next to the body and anything lit, unless the body has night vision
268. **[DOOR-07](findings/DOOR-07-door-reported-open-when-only-the-engineer-can-open-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): An engineer sent to open a door for someone else reports it open when it only opens to the engineer, or was open for a moment
   - Fix: Tell the tool who the door is for, and force a door that opens only to the engineer's own ID so that it is left standing open, and do not count a door that will shut by itself as open
269. **[DRV-05](findings/DRV-05-line-to-say-waits-on-the-model-with-no-limit.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): A line the work calls for holds the whole body still until the model has answered or timed out, 60 seconds a call and one NPC at a time
   - Fix: Give a line its work calls for a wait of its own (about 8 seconds, as a choice has), after which the plain line is said by code and the body goes on
270. **[HAND-08](findings/HAND-08-errand-one-tile-off-through-a-wall-or-window-counts-as-arrived.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): An errand target one tile off through a wall or a window counts as reached at once, so the body gives up on it without a step, every time
   - Fix: In crew_npc_reach count arrival only when can_reach_target_now is true, and when get_dist is within reach but a wall or window is between, walk to an open tile beside the target from which it can be reached
271. **[JAN-03](findings/JAN-03-filthy-rag-still-counted-as-a-tool-and-never-washed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A rag grows filthy with blood and then cleans nothing, but is still counted as a tool, so every mess after is written off and the rag is never rinsed at a sink
   - Fix: Count a rag with blood_level 10 or more as a spent tool in can_clean_with, and add a step that rinses it at a sink in sight the way a player does, by a plain click with the rag
272. **[JOBS-01](findings/JOBS-01-security-officer-cargo-and-engineering-taken-for-cargo-staff-and-engineers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A department security officer, Security Officer (Cargo) or (Engineering), is taken for a cargo technician or a station engineer
   - Fix: Send each person's base job title from the server (crew_npc_job_of(person).title) beside the ID assignment and match jobs on that, or failing that strip a trailing bracketed department before matching
273. **[KNA-09](findings/KNA-09-warrant-held-by-an-officer-who-is-down-is-never-served.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant given to an officer who then goes down or falls silent is never served by anyone
   - Fix: Have whoever keeps the list take a warrant back when the officer it went to has sent no word on it for some minutes, or is seen lying on the floor
274. **[KNA-10](findings/KNA-10-door-that-opens-to-engineer-id-reported-open-unopened.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer sent to a door that its own ID opens reports the door open without opening it
   - Fix: When the door opens to the engineer's ID, have it open the door and hold it for security, and say the door is open only when it stands open
275. **[KNA-19](findings/KNA-19-room-in-parts-one-door-opens-so-whole-room-is-taken-for-open.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A room split by inner locked doors counts as open if one outer door opens, so janitors set off for a part of it they cannot reach (the Research Division, no route)
   - Fix: Work out which part of a room the body can get into from the doors that open for it, and pick the spot to walk to, and the messes that are its to clean, from that part only
276. **[KNA-23](findings/KNA-23-officer-looks-for-someone-by-standing-at-the-first-spot-of-the-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The officer looks for someone by standing for 20 seconds at the first spot it reaches in the room, so in a room wider than its sight it does not see them
   - Fix: After the first look from the arrival spot, walk to the middle of the room and then to its far end before the room is counted as looked in
277. **[KNA-28](findings/KNA-28-no-way-out-of-the-closet-is-a-sealed-maintenance-pocket-then-an-empty-shut-in-test.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): The "no way out" of the Custodial Closet at round start is a walk to a sealed corner of the maintenance next door, followed by a shut-in test that tests nothing
   - Fix: Pick the spot to walk to in a room only from the squares joined by floor to a door the body can open, and do not count shut in from a test that tried no route
278. **[MULTI-01](findings/MULTI-01-with-two-officers-sightings-and-let-go-go-to-whichever-is-in-sight.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): With a Head of Security and two officers, sightings, let-go orders and repeat gives go to whichever officer is in sight, not to the one holding the warrant
   - Fix: Record on each desk warrant the officer it was given to, and send that warrant's sightings, let-go and re-gives to that officer only, choosing a new one only when the holder is down, hurt or gone
279. **[PERF-08](findings/PERF-08-ui-data-works-out-the-same-things-many-times-per-body-per-update.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): ui_data works out the same things over and over for every body on every update - four walks of up to 300 remembered messes, two or three of every PDA, a fresh view for security and engineering, about ten ID card lookups
   - Fix: Work out each body's sense-derived fields once per look into a snapshot list on the controller, have ui_data copy the snapshot and add only the cheap live fields, and pass the look's sight list to security_state and engineering_state
280. **[SEC-09](findings/SEC-09-every-cuffs-failure-is-told-as-they-would-not-stay-still.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Every way the cuffs fail is told as they would not stay still, so someone who cannot be cuffed is batoned again every half minute for good
   - Fix: Have put_cuffs_on say why it failed (cannot_cuff, no_hand, moved) and send that reason back, and have the window give up on cannot_cuff and not set force for anything but moved
281. **[SECT-10](findings/SECT-10-thanks-or-a-question-by-pda-gets-i-did-not-follow-that.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Any PDA message from the Captain or a head to security that is not an order, such as thanks or a question, is answered I did not follow that with the warrant wording
   - Fix: Send not followed only when the message has an order word in it or the reading was a warrant or pardon that did not take, and hand everything else to the voice as a PDA to answer
282. **[SENSE-06](findings/SENSE-06-walking-onto-a-known-peel-or-soap-still-slips.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A body that knows a banana peel, soap or foam lies ahead slows to a walk and steps on it anyway, and walking does not stop those from slipping anyone
   - Fix: Walk only for a slippery thing whose lube_flags hold NO_SLIP_WHEN_WALKING, and for the rest refuse the step and go round the tile (or pick the thing up), the owner to choose
283. **[SIM-08](findings/SIM-08-stand-in-mop-never-dries-and-is-wetted-anywhere.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): In the simulator a mop never dries, spray never runs out, a dry mop is wetted with no water in sight, and the bucket fields are never sent
   - Fix: Give the stand-in's mop and spray a store of water and cleaner that each clean uses up, fail a clean with a dry mop and no water in sight in the server's words, and send water_from, bucket_to_fill, wants_bucket and beyond_kinds
284. **[SUP-02](findings/SUP-02-order-given-up-is-told-to-nobody-and-stays-in-the-cart.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): An order the technician gives up on is told to nobody, stays in the cart, and later arrives as a crate nobody knows about
   - Fix: On giving up, owe a notice to whoever ordered and keep the order's manifest numbers so its crates are held when they do come
285. **[SUP-09](findings/SUP-09-crate-contents-that-are-not-items-do-not-count.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Only small items count as what a crate holds, so a crate with a filing cabinet or a janitorial cart in it is called empty, "unpacked" with the thing still inside, and sent back to be sold
   - Fix: Count everything a crate holds, not only /obj/item, and unpack by opening the crate so that what cannot be lifted comes out too
286. **[SUP-12](findings/SUP-12-crate-put-aboard-to-be-sold-is-hauled-back-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A crate a player puts aboard the docked supply shuttle to be sold is taken for one that came in on it, hauled off into the bay, and stops the shuttle leaving until it is
   - Fix: Note which crates are aboard when the shuttle docks at the station and unload only those, so a crate put aboard afterwards goes out with the shuttle
287. **[SUP-17](findings/SUP-17-held-crate-a-player-takes-and-unpacks-is-written-off-as-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A held crate that a player takes away and unpacks, the one who ordered it among them, is written off as lost and emptied, and its owner is told so and may have it bought again
   - Fix: Treat a held crate that has left cargo's rooms in the hands of someone who is not crew as collected, and only call one emptied in cargo's own rooms lost
288. **[TRA-02](findings/TRA-02-head-asking-again-at-the-counter-is-sold-a-second-crate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A head who asks again at the counter is ordered a second crate though cargo is already holding one for it, and the head cannot hear a spoken word that its crate is in
   - Fix: At the counter, answer a head's order with the number of any crate already held for it in a fixed line and offer no order for that kind, and have the head read that line, and an overheard has-come-in, the same as the PDA message
289. **[TRA-04](findings/TRA-04-any-word-from-cargo-in-earshot-counts-as-the-order-taken.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): At the counter, anything any cargo worker says in the head's hearing counts as its order being taken, so an order nobody took is not asked again for ten minutes
   - Fix: Have the technician who places a head's order say a fixed line naming the head and what was ordered, and count only that line, said to the head, as the order taken
290. **[TRA-05](findings/TRA-05-word-of-an-old-crate-wipes-the-heads-newer-order.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): Word that an older crate has come or is still waiting wipes out the head's newer order in hand, so the Captain's no to the newer one is never read and those it was for are never ordered for again
   - Fix: Keep the Quartermaster's order number on the head's order from its Noted line, put the order number in every word about crates, and clear the order in hand only when the word is about that order
291. **[TRB-11](findings/TRB-11-pardon-of-someone-in-a-cell-goes-only-to-the-officer-who-put-them-there.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A pardon for someone in a cell is passed only to the officer, so with the officer down or gone nobody opens the cell, though the Captain is told at once that it is done
   - Fix: When the desk strikes someone it knows to be in a cell, have whoever keeps the list free them itself if the officer does not say they are free in a minute or two, going to the brig and stopping the cell it was told of
292. **[TRC-04](findings/TRC-04-two-failed-walks-to-an-engine-machine-stop-the-lighting-for-good-with-the-wrong-reason.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): Two lighting steps that fail for any reason, a blocked walk or a full hand included, stop the lighting for good, and the Chief Engineer and the Captain are told the machine will not take
   - Fix: Pass the server's reason for a failed work_machine to the brain, count towards the stop only a machine that would not take, retry a walk or hand failure after a back-off, and say the true reason when it does stop
293. **[TRUST-03](findings/TRUST-03-speaker-rank-read-from-the-voice-name-alone.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Who said something is taken from the voice alone, so a voice made to sound like the Captain is the Captain, whoever is standing there
   - Fix: Send the face the voice comes from with each line heard, and have the window take the speaker's rank from the person behind the handle, never from the voice name or the PDA list
294. **[TRUST-04](findings/TRUST-04-held-crate-handed-to-anyone-who-names-its-owner.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A crate held for a head is put out for anyone who says they have come for it, by number or just by the head's name or job
   - Fix: Release a held crate only to whoever it is for, to their own staff, or to someone they have named by PDA, and ask anyone else who sent them
295. **[TRUST-06](findings/TRUST-06-warrant-checked-against-one-person-served-on-anyone-whose-name-fits.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Who a warrant may be on is checked against one person, and the officer then arrests anyone in sight whose name holds the warrant's words, a head of staff included
   - Fix: Settle a warrant on one known person by full name at the moment it is declared, refuse a name that fits more than one, and have the officer check the person in front of it is that one and not a head before it lays a hand on them
296. **[API-02](findings/API-02-voice-name-and-seen-name-differ.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): The server names one person three ways, and the window matches a voice to a face by name, so a Captain whose ID shows an honorific is never obeyed
   - Fix: Find the speaker among people_in_view by details.handle, which the server already ties to the voice, and fall back to the name only when there is no handle
297. **[ARR-06](findings/ARR-06-door-opened-by-the-captain-is-not-walked-through.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): The officer asks the Captain to let it in, and when the Captain opens the door it does not go through
   - Fix: Tell the brain when the door it is standing at is open, and have letInStep walk through it at once whoever opened it
298. **[ASYNC-01](findings/ASYNC-01-nearest-to-speaker-decided-before-the-others-have-heard.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): Who is nearest a line put to several is decided before the others have heard it, so two NPCs often both answer
   - Fix: Decide nearest on the server for the hearers of one line, or have the window hold a group line a second and decide once every hearer's event is in
299. **[CARGO-09](findings/CARGO-09-note-that-someone-is-inside-never-lapses.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): A note that a visitor is inside a locked room never lapses, so one who left unseen has the door tried for them for good and stops orders, rounds and janitor calls
   - Fix: Strike the note when a let-out fails because they are not in that room, give the note an age limit, and do not let a standing door want switch off order-taking
300. **[DESK-08](findings/DESK-08-told-of-a-mess-in-a-big-room-it-looks-from-the-door-and-says-it-is-cleaned.md)** (not checked, finder likely, janitor): Told of a mess in a room bigger than it can see, a janitor stands inside the door five seconds, sees none, and tells the caller it is cleaned up
   - Fix: Before a told mess task is finished with no mess seen, have the body walk the room once (a look-round step), and say it found no mess rather than that the mess is cleaned up
301. **[DOOR-02](findings/DOOR-02-locked-out-of-ignores-open-ways-in.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): A room with an open way in (shutters up, a gap with no door) is still taken as locked to the body
   - Fix: Have locked_out_of answer FALSE for a room that has an open doorless way in, using the test crew_npc_room_is_closed already makes, kept for a minute per room
302. **[KNA-03](findings/KNA-03-janitor-in-cargo-bay-walks-at-its-locked-door.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): A janitor let into the Cargo Bay walks into its locked lobby door for five seconds, then asks out by the wrong door
   - Fix: End a walk at once when the route just planned runs through a shut airlock that is locked to the body, say which door, and ask to be let out by that door
303. **[KNA-13](findings/KNA-13-warehouse-no-route-is-crates-sealing-the-door-pocket.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): The Warehouse has no route in most rounds because random crates wall its one airlock off from the rest of the room
   - Fix: When no route reaches the spot picked in a room, try the tile inside each door the body can open, and let cargo staff press the button that opens a room's shutters
304. **[KNB-01](findings/KNB-01-warehouse-walled-off-by-its-own-crates.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): Nobody can walk into the Warehouse - crates spawn across its floor just inside its only airlock, and no body can press the shutter button
   - Fix: Walk to a spot the body has a route to (just inside the door its ID opens) when the chosen spot has none, and give bodies a way to press a door button they can see
305. **[QM-03](findings/QM-03-two-technicians-with-one-first-name.md)** (not checked, finder likely, quartermaster): Two technicians with one first name both place every order given to either, and the meeting deals out their work for ever and never closes
   - Fix: Address a technician by first name only when no other technician aboard shares it, else by full name, and read the full name back on both sides
306. **[SUP-15](findings/SUP-15-crate-boxed-in-on-the-squares-is-written-off-as-lost.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): Crates are packed onto the bay's block of squares until the middle ones cannot be reached, and a held crate there is then written off as lost, with the count never set back
   - Fix: Let free_square take only a square that leaves every crate on the squares with a free tile beside it, and set entry.unreachable back to 0 whenever the crate is reached
307. **[TRB-04](findings/TRB-04-a-wanted-person-found-dead-is-cuffed-dragged-to-a-cell-and-reported-jailed.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A wanted person found dead is told they are under arrest, cuffed, dragged to a cell and reported to the Captain as jailed, and the cell then counts as empty
   - Fix: Send a dead flag with each person in view, and have serveStep report a wanted person found dead as an outcome to the desk instead of arresting them, the desk then telling the Captain and striking the warrant

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 2

308. **[ENG-02](findings/ENG-02-emitter-switched-on-but-unpowered-is-taken-for-firing.md)** (confirmed, engineering): An emitter that is switched on but has no power is taken for a firing one, so a dead engine is reported lit and sent to be relit every five minutes for ever
   - Fix: Have switch_emitter and the machine state count an emitter as firing only when it is active and powered, and give the relight a reason word back so the Chief Engineer stops sending it and tells the Captain the emitters have no power
309. **[KNB-07](findings/KNB-07-door-tool-finds-people-through-walls-and-reads-their-mind.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): The door tool finds the person it is opening for through a shut door, by name or by job, and reads which door they want straight from their controller
   - Fix: Open the door that was named by the knock, the PDA message or the speech, and learn who is there by seeing them once it is open

## Bugs: low (102)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 99

310. **[ARR-18](findings/ARR-18-each-new-go-at-it-by-the-same-attacker-is-told-to-the-captain-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Every fresh go at security by the same person with no warrant, once it has been stopped, is told to the Head of Security and the Captain again
   - Fix: Keep when each attacker was last reported in beat, by name, and report the same person again only after some minutes or once a warrant on them has come and gone
311. **[ASYNC-03](findings/ASYNC-03-putting-back-kept-by-task-number-shared-by-all-janitors.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Which janitor is putting its mop back is kept by task number alone, and every janitor numbers its tasks from 1
   - Fix: Key puttingBack by brain id and task id (or keep it on the brain), and clear it in stopSession
312. **[ASYNC-04](findings/ASYNC-04-talk-waits-behind-a-choice-and-behind-the-first-in-line.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A reply that is sitting out its short cooldown lets a job choice take the model first, and holds up every other NPC's reply behind it
   - Fix: In startTalk take the first queued NPC that is ready, not only the head of the queue, and do not start a choice while a talk is due within a few seconds
313. **[BRAIN-08](findings/BRAIN-08-reasons-cut-off-mid-word-by-the-schema-and-fed-back.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): One reason in four for a feeling and one in eight for a job choice is cut off mid-word by the reply schema, and the stump is fed back into later prompts
   - Fix: Ask for a reason in a few words in the prompt, raise the schema maxLength well above the kept length, and cut the kept text back to its last whole word or clause
314. **[BRAIN-10](findings/BRAIN-10-wrong-or-missing-model-shown-as-ready.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): With qwen3.5 9b not installed the window takes whichever model Ollama lists first, embedding models too, and with none at all it still says Ollama ready
   - Fix: Choose only a chat model, prefer one whose name starts with the preferred family, and show a warning instead of Ollama ready when the preferred model is missing or nothing usable is installed
315. **[CARGO-16](findings/CARGO-16-whoever-is-knocking-is-booked-as-a-person-inside-the-bay.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Let out of an inner room after an unnamed knock, the stand-in name whoever is knocking is booked as a person inside the outer room, and stays there for the round
   - Fix: In afterActing never book SOMEONE_INSIDE in the department's list, and better book whoever the server says it opened for
316. **[CHK-01](findings/CHK-01-voice-test-crashes-fixture-brain-out-of-step.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): voice.ts crashes part way through because the test brain in fixtures.ts lacks fields the window code now reads
   - Fix: Make the blank brain in one exported function in the window code and have both ingest and fixtures.ts call it
317. **[CHK-04](findings/CHK-04-job-module-loaded-first-crashes-at-import.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Loading any job's file before the rest of the window code throws at import, because jobs/index.ts builds its list while the jobs are still loading
   - Fix: Build the JOBS list the first time jobFor is called, not when jobs/index.ts is loaded
318. **[CHK-06](findings/CHK-06-two-dead-names-in-janitor-the-type-check-would-flag.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Two names in jobs/janitor.ts are never read - a wait constant left from the first build and the via argument of letInStep
   - Fix: Delete WAIT_AT_COUNTER_DS, and drop the via parameter of letInStep (or use it), so the only wait at a locked door is LET_IN_WAIT_DS
319. **[CHK-08](findings/CHK-08-sim-end-checks-fail-on-work-still-under-way-at-the-cut-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Two simulator scenarios fail by chance because their end checks read the crew at a fixed second, with a look round or a reminder still under way
   - Fix: Stop starting new held checks and look rounds in the last minute of a scenario and run the clock on until no body has a walk or a message in hand, before the end checks
320. **[CORE-05](findings/CORE-05-every-ack-rebuilds-and-resends-the-whole-crew.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Every ack the window sends makes the server rebuild and resend every body's whole state, though nothing the window shows has changed
   - Fix: Return FALSE from ui_act for ack, as brain_log already does, since the window already knows the number it has just sent
321. **[CORE-08](findings/CORE-08-walk-back-to-post-cancels-work-begun-in-the-tenth-of-a-second-before.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): The walk back to the post starts a tenth of a second after it is decided without looking again, and silently cancels any walk, errand or search the brain began in between
   - Fix: Start the return walk through a small proc that first checks no walk, errand or search has begun and the body is still off its spot, and does nothing if one has
322. **[DESK-04](findings/DESK-04-putting-back-marks-are-shared-by-every-janitor-by-task-number.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): The note that a janitor is putting its mop and bucket back is kept by task number for every janitor at once, so one janitor's note steers another
   - Fix: Keep the putting-back note on the task itself, as task.puttingBack, instead of in a module-wide Set of task ids
323. **[DESK-12](findings/DESK-12-no-soap-or-rag-reply-is-not-read-by-cargo-as-needing-scrubbing.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A janitor's I have no soap or rag reply is not read by cargo as the mess wanting scrubbing, so the next janitor is asked plainly to come and try
   - Fix: Word the janitor's reply with NEEDS_SCRUBBING (it needs scrubbing with soap or a rag), or widen cargo's test to soap or (a )?rag
324. **[DOOR-10](findings/DOOR-10-plastic-flaps-rule-turns-back-crawlers-and-riders.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Our plastic flaps rule refuses a route to a mob lying down, riding a mulebot or phasing, all of which the flaps let through
   - Fix: Let the route through when the one asking is lying down or buckled to a mulebot, read from the pass info, and say in the comment what the rule cannot know
325. **[DOOR-13](findings/DOOR-13-go-to-door-of-a-visited-place-off-the-station-is-a-runtime.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Going to the door of a place the body has stood in that is not a station room, a shuttle say, is a runtime and the brain gets no answer
   - Fix: In tool_go_to_door answer FALSE when the named place has no station area, and give crew_npc_doors_of a null guard
326. **[DOOR-17](findings/DOOR-17-door-with-its-id-scanner-off-taken-as-opening-to-the-id.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door whose ID scanner is cut or switched off opens to nobody, and the door code takes it as opening to everyone whose ID has the access
   - Fix: Add one helper for whether a door will open to a body by hand, requiresID and allowed and power and no bolts or weld, and use it wherever the door code now asks allowed alone
327. **[DOOR-18](findings/DOOR-18-armour-plate-seal-and-no-panel-tried-twice-and-reported-as-would-not-open.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door with armour plating, a seal or no panel is gone at twice, and security and the Captain are told only that it would not open
   - Fix: Give the lasting causes their own reasons (plated, sealed, no_panel), add them to the final list in forcing.ts and give whyNot words for each
328. **[DRV-02](findings/DRV-02-step-clear-count-never-starts-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Having stepped clear twice in a room, a body never steps clear in that room again, on any later visit
   - Fix: Start the count again when the body leaves the room, and clear the map in stopSession
329. **[DRV-04](findings/DRV-04-talk-hold-start-goes-stale.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The start of a talk hold is kept from an earlier conversation, so a body spoken to later walks off at once
   - Fix: Clear heldSince whenever drive returns without reaching the hold, or count the hold from lastSpokenToAt
330. **[DRV-08](findings/DRV-08-after-stepping-aside-nothing-at-all-for-fifteen-seconds.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Having stepped aside, the body takes no step of any kind for 15 seconds, so a second ask to move, an order, being told to leave and a door held for it all wait
   - Fix: Keep the body off its own routine work for ASIDE_HOLD_MS with a hold of its own, not by putting driveAfter forward, so that anything ahead of routine work still goes at once
331. **[DRV-09](findings/DRV-09-shut-in-try-at-leaving-spent-on-a-step-held-for-talk.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Shut in, its next try at leaving is spent on a walk the talk hold then stops, so it waits another 20 seconds, or two minutes if it was let in, before it really tries
   - Fix: Set tryLeavingAt only once the walk is really issued, after the pause after saying and the talk hold, not where the gate is checked
332. **[DRV-10](findings/DRV-10-llm-status-line-is-set-once-and-never-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The window's Ollama line is worked out once when it opens and never again, so it shows ready while every call fails, or unreachable while calls work
   - Fix: Keep the outcome of the last few real LLM calls in brain.ts and show that in the status line, and pick a fallback model that can chat
333. **[ENG-07](findings/ENG-07-light-order-sent-by-pda-is-never-answered-and-is-sent-again-every-minute.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer given the engine by PDA never answers that it has it, so the Chief Engineer sends the order again every minute until the engine is lit
   - Fix: Have the engineer answer a light order that came by PDA with "The engine, right away." by PDA, and let the Chief Engineer give the order at most twice before it waits on the lit or stuck word instead
334. **[ENG-12](findings/ENG-12-captain-told-i-do-not-know-this-engine-by-the-chief-engineer.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): On any map but MetaStation the Captain is told by the Chief Engineer "The engine is not lit - I do not know this engine", the engineer's "I" passed on as the chief's own
   - Fix: Word the unknown-engine reason without I, for example "the engine room is not one engineering has the steps for", as whyNot does for doors
335. **[HAND-09](findings/HAND-09-explore-walk-broken-off-for-any-reason-writes-the-room-off-for-the-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): An explore walk that ends for any reason, a stun or a queue at a door included, writes the room off as unreachable for the rest of the round
   - Fix: Write a room into unreachable_places from walk_finished only when the reason is CREW_NPC_NO_WAY, and give the other failures a time after which the room may be tried again
336. **[HAND-11](findings/HAND-11-unasked-thing-kept-for-good-after-a-minute-busy-or-a-second-gift.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A thing pushed into its hand is kept for good if the body stays busy for a minute, or if a second thing is pushed into the other hand before the first is put down
   - Fix: Keep a list of unasked things, not one, and when busy keep waiting as long as the thing is still held instead of giving up after ten tries
337. **[HAND-13](findings/HAND-13-fetch-from-a-locker-takes-an-empty-spray-bottle.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A fetch from a locker takes the first thing of that name, an empty spray bottle included, though every other pick up passes empty ones over
   - Fix: Skip is_spent things in take_from_container as tool_pick_up does, and count them in what the locker holds
338. **[HAND-14](findings/HAND-14-crate-behind-a-shut-door-is-known-to-be-there.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A crate on the far side of a shut airlock counts as seen, so the body knows a crate it cannot see is jammed there and sets off to move it
   - Fix: In crate_in_the_way count a crate as seen only if it is in view itself, and when only the door is in view walk to the door first and look again
339. **[HEAD-08](findings/HEAD-08-one-crate-unpacked-tells-everyone-waiting-on-any-order.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Word that one crate is unpacked tells everyone the head has ordered for that their things have come, including those whose order has not arrived
   - Fix: Record on each ask the order and crate numbers it is waiting on, and on word that crate N is unpacked tell only the asks whose crate that was
340. **[HEAD-09](findings/HEAD-09-pickup-turn-indexes-a-list-that-is-reordered-each-time.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Who is sent for a crate is picked by a round-wide counter into a list that is put in a new order every time, so after the first crate the one who asked is seldom the one sent
   - Fix: Send the askers of an order first in order of asking, counting from zero for each order, and keep the round-wide turn only for the crates beyond the askers
341. **[JAN-07](findings/JAN-07-custodial-locator-read-with-the-network-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): The custodial locator is read with the station network down, though the program needs it, and the closet is named when the locator shows no gear there
   - Fix: In has_custodial_locator check computer.get_ntnet_status() as engine_reading does, and say plainly when the locator shows nothing rather than naming a room it did not show
342. **[JAN-14](findings/JAN-14-dry-sink-still-taken-as-water-and-a-missed-click-reported-as-run-dry.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A sink that has run dry is still taken as water to hand, and a wetting whose click never landed is reported as the sink having run dry
   - Fix: Take a sink as water only with 5 units or more in it, as a mop bucket is taken only with water in it, and in wet_mop tell a click that could not be made from a sink with no water
343. **[JOBS-07](findings/JOBS-07-mail-never-handed-to-someone-whose-id-shows-an-honorific.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Mail is never handed to someone whose ID shows an honorific, such as Captain John, because the mail is listed under the real name and the person in view goes by the shown name
   - Fix: Have freight_state send, for each name in mail_for, the handle of that person when they are in view (matched by mind on the server), and match DELIVER on that handle instead of on the name
344. **[KNA-12](findings/KNA-12-voice-not-told-how-a-forcing-job-ended.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Once a door-forcing job is closed the voice is told nothing of how it ended, and says the door is forced when it is not
   - Fix: Keep the outcome of the last forcing job for a few minutes and give it to the voice as a cue
345. **[KNA-14](findings/KNA-14-warrant-over-fifteen-minutes-cut-without-saying.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant declared for more than 15 minutes is cut to 15 and the answer does not say so
   - Fix: Keep the minutes that were asked for beside the minutes given, and add the sentence about the cell timer to the first answer as the later one already has it
346. **[KNA-17](findings/KNA-17-mess-calls-one-message-a-room-and-to-janitors-who-are-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician sends a janitor one PDA message for every room with a mess, seconds apart, and sends them to a janitor it can see lying on the floor
   - Fix: Put every room that is due a call into one message to the same janitor, and pass over a janitor who is seen to be down
347. **[KNA-20](findings/KNA-20-kitchen-door-counted-as-a-door-of-the-bar.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Any airlock beside any square of a room is taken for a door of it, so the Kitchen's door is a third door of the Bar, with both its sides on fridges
   - Fix: In crew_npc_doors_of keep a door only when its inside and outside tiles are on its line of passage and neither holds a dense machine or table
348. **[KNA-22](findings/KNA-22-anyone-seen-inside-cargo-is-told-to-the-voice-as-let-in-by-staff.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Anyone a technician sees inside a cargo room is described to its voice as let in by someone who works here, though nobody let them in
   - Fix: Say let in only of those on record as let in, and give those merely seen inside a cue that says nobody here is known to have let them in
349. **[KNA-24](findings/KNA-24-crate-left-off-the-squares-is-never-put-on-one-once-a-square-frees.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A crate cargo once left off the marked squares is never put on one, even after a square comes free, and the log never says where a hauled crate ended
