   - Fix: Clear crew_npc_left_on when a square comes free that was not free when the crate was left, and name the tile in the log line for every haul
350. **[KNB-02](findings/KNB-02-no-route-log-asks-the-same-pathfinder-twice.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The no-route log line says the game's other pathfinder finds none either, but it asks the same pathfinder a second time
   - Fix: Drop the second opinion from log_no_route and print what the route search actually met instead, a flood fill from the body that names the furthest tile reached and what stands on the next ones
351. **[KNB-16](findings/KNB-16-change-log-says-built-plans-are-not-built.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The change log's last line says the dropped-crates plan is not built and the no-cheats plan is built only for the mail chute, and the no-cheats plan says nothing in it is built
   - Fix: Rewrite the last line of the change log from the plans' Status sections, and give the no-cheats plan a Status section that says what is built
352. **[KNB-18](findings/KNB-18-simulator-budget-free-without-a-quartermaster-and-twice-the-real-start.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The simulator charges nothing for an order when no Quartermaster is aboard, and starts cargo's budget at 2,000 credits where a real round starts with 500 to 1,000
   - Fix: Charge every order to the simulated budget as the server does, whoever is aboard, and start it at what a real round starts with, raised only in the scenarios that need more
353. **[LIFE-04](findings/LIFE-04-after-the-look-a-container-is-worked-from-wherever-the-body-is.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): After the look into a locker or crate the body takes things out and shuts it from wherever it now is, awake or not
   - Fix: After the sleep in take_from_container, look_inside and take_mail, go on only if the errand is the same one and the body can still reach the container and act, else leave it as it is
354. **[LIFE-06](findings/LIFE-06-window-is-sent-a-half-built-list-of-who-is-in-view.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The window is sent, and acts on, a list of who is in view that is only half rebuilt, each time someone new comes into sight
   - Fix: In look_around build people_in_view in a local list, assign it once the loop is done, and emit the comes-into-view events after that
355. **[LIFE-07](findings/LIFE-07-crate-pushed-on-by-a-body-that-is-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A body knocked down or killed while pushing a crate clear goes on stepping and pushing it
   - Fix: Before each body.Move in push_clear, stop unless the body can move as the walk loop would let it, and say why it stopped
356. **[LOGB-07](findings/LOGB-07-could-not-get-the-crate-out-is-told-after-it-got-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician tells the Quartermaster it could not get a crate out to the lobby after it has got it out, and the Quartermaster sends another technician to see to it
   - Fix: Clear brain.gaveUp when a later haul of the same crate succeeds, and have the Quartermaster check the held crates before it sends anyone to see to one
357. **[MEM-03](findings/MEM-03-news-about-a-person-is-thrown-away-as-a-sighting.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): News about a person is thrown away as a sighting if it says meet, or is and any room name inside any word
   - Fix: In isSighting match room names as whole words, drop meeting from the met words, and call a note a sighting only if it has nothing else in it beyond the name, a verb of being or seeing and the room
358. **[MEM-09](findings/MEM-09-second-person-to-ask-for-the-same-work-is-never-told-it-is-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): The second person to ask for the same work is never told it is done, and an order merged into an old task reports to the first asker
   - Fix: Keep a list of everyone waiting on a task, not one askedBy, and owe each of them word when it is done, the latest superior first
359. **[MEM-10](findings/MEM-10-someone-seen-through-a-window-is-remembered-as-in-the-npcs-own-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Someone seen through a window or an open door is remembered as being in the NPC's own room
   - Fix: In observe record person.place, the room the server says they stand in, and fall back to npc.location only when it is missing
360. **[MEM-12](findings/MEM-12-my-bodys-hands-are-full-is-said-as-is-hands-are-full.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): My body's hands are full is said aloud as I's hands are full, and was becomes am
   - Fix: Add rules for my body's and your body's before the bare ones, keep the tense of was, and only strip a third-person s from verbs that are not es-forms
361. **[MEM-14](findings/MEM-14-rooms-only-heard-of-are-described-as-visited-and-seen-empty.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Rooms the NPC has only been told of are described to the model as rooms it visited and saw nothing in
   - Fix: Keep lastVisit unset for rooms learned without going there, and describe them as known of, not seen, until the body has stood in them
362. **[MEM-15](findings/MEM-15-a-whispered-request-is-answered-but-nothing-asked-in-it-is-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): A whispered request is answered but nothing asked in it can be agreed to, because every reader looks for says
   - Fix: Match says or whispers wherever a report line is read for speech, through one helper, and keep whispered lines out of what is put back after a failed call
363. **[MULTI-05](findings/MULTI-05-second-order-from-one-asker-within-two-minutes-is-dropped-by-the-free-technician.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A second order from the same person within two minutes is refused by the free technician because the busy one took the first, and nobody places it though the voice says it will
   - Fix: Key an order claim by the asker and what was asked for, or let a claim go as soon as the claimer has placed its order, so a second asking can be taken by a technician who is free
364. **[MULTI-09](findings/MULTI-09-knock-from-inside-left-to-the-quartermaster-by-name-order-and-nobody-goes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A knock from inside a cargo room is left to whoever in cargo has the first name in the alphabet, the Quartermaster included, so with the Quartermaster in sight neither technician goes
   - Fix: In the name-order tie-break count only technicians who are on their feet and not busy (isTechnician, not down, not cuffed, not hauling), not the Quartermaster
365. **[PARSE-11](findings/PARSE-11-words-in-double-quotes-are-cut-out-of-what-was-heard.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Words a speaker puts in double quotes are cut out of what the crew hear, so there is blood all over the bar with blood quoted names no mess
   - Fix: Take the words from the event's details.message, or from the first quote after says to the last quote before (person, never by pairing quote marks
366. **[PARSE-12](findings/PARSE-12-a-whispered-line-is-heard-but-never-read-as-said.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A line whispered to a crew member wakes it but is never read as said, so whatever it agrees to is refused as nothing said called for it
   - Fix: Treat says and whispers alike in every report filter, through one helper isSpeechLine, or have describeEvent write every heard line with says
367. **[PARSE-18](findings/PARSE-18-ok-go-check-the-bar-may-go-unanswered.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): An order that begins with ok, thanks or alright, ok go check the bar, is taken as a goodbye that needs no answer, so the order is carried out without a word back
   - Fix: In buildTalk never allow silence when an order was made out or work was told, and in needsNoAnswer require the line to be nothing but the closing words, give or take a name and please
368. **[PERF-01](findings/PERF-01-href-log-is-99-percent-crew-traffic.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): href.log and href.log.json are 99 percent crew traffic, every brain log record written there in full a second time, past the trim and the rate limit
   - Fix: Send acks for all crew as one act per update, stop sending a ROUTINE brain log record that repeats the last one for that body, and ask the owner whether tgui may skip logging the payload of a crew brain link act
369. **[PERF-07](findings/PERF-07-ui-data-does-work-in-the-world-lost-crates-written-off-there.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Building the window's data does work in the world - a lost crate is written off, said aloud and owed a PDA message from inside ui_data, and shuttle crates and held crates are marked there
   - Fix: Move write_off_lost_crates and the held-crate and shuttle-crate marking into the cargo body's once-a-second look, and leave held_state and freight_state reading only
370. **[QM-06](findings/QM-06-word-of-an-order-not-in-its-book-is-answered-and-dropped.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): Word that an order has come in is answered I have that even when the order is not in the Quartermaster's book, so the crate numbers reach nobody
   - Fix: Say I have that to has-come-in word only when noteDocked found the order, so the technician falls back to sending the numbers to whoever ordered, and read the book before taking new orders after the window is reopened
371. **[QM-09](findings/QM-09-captain-who-refuses-paper-is-asked-again-every-five-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): A Captain who says no to the Quartermaster's own crate of paper is asked about a new one every five minutes for the rest of the round
   - Fix: In orderForItself, do not order again a crate the Captain has refused, or not for a long while, and say so in the cues
372. **[QM-11](findings/QM-11-order-that-will-not-go-through-is-given-again-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): An order a technician says did not go through is given out again every two minutes with no limit, and whoever ordered is never told
   - Fix: Count the failures on the order, tell whoever ordered after the second, and after the third hold it and tell the Captain, instead of giving it out again
373. **[SEC-11](findings/SEC-11-pardon-with-cuffs-left-on-is-reported-freed-and-never-retried.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A pardon whose cuffs would not come off is reported to the Captain as freed and never tried again, leaving the person in security's cuffs
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing for free, treat ok with cuffs_left as not done, keep the toFree entry for another try, and say so in the outcome after the last try
374. **[SEC-12](findings/SEC-12-prisoner-who-steps-out-of-the-cell-in-sight-is-reported-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A prisoner who steps out of the cell behind the officer, in plain sight and in its cuffs, is reported to the Head of Security as lost
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing for jail, push the lost outcome only when got_away comes without a handle, and set lastSeen from details.place
375. **[SEC-16](findings/SEC-16-free-name-from-the-window-goes-into-the-log-uncapped.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The name sent with free is written into game.log and back to the brain as it came, with no length cap and no line breaks taken out
   - Fix: In tool_free, cut person_name down the way tool_order cuts for_name (the not_a_name regex and MAX_NAME_LEN) before it is matched, stored or logged
376. **[SECT-14](findings/SECT-14-a-stranger-whose-name-is-inside-anothers-is-counted-as-asked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A second stranger whose first name is inside the words said to the first, Ian beside Brian, is counted as asked and is put out without a question
   - Fix: In guardAfterSaying match the first name as a whole word, and better still note which stranger the step was for instead of searching the line
377. **[SECT-18](findings/SECT-18-warden-and-detective-are-not-counted-as-security.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A Warden or Detective is not counted as security, so a warrant on one is taken and one who brings a warrant is told to take it to their head
   - Fix: Make isSecurity true for every job of the Security department in hierarchy.ts, Warden and Detective included, and keep isOfficer for who makes arrests
378. **[SECT-19](findings/SECT-19-nobody-or-lost-anywhere-in-an-answer-is-owning-up.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An answer with nobody, no one or lost anywhere in it, such as Nobody was at the counter so Donna let me in, is taken as owning up to having no business there
   - Fix: Look for a workmate's name first and let it win, and take nobody or no one only at the start of the answer or as nobody sent me
379. **[SECT-23](findings/SECT-23-try-again-anywhere-in-the-captains-line-sends-a-hurt-officer-back-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Try again anywhere in what the Captain sends security, Don't try again until you are healed included, sends a hurt officer back to making arrests
   - Fix: Take try again only as the whole order or at its start, with no negation before it, and only while some security member is out hurt
380. **[SECT-24](findings/SECT-24-five-of-them-for-resisting-said-when-the-cap-ate-them.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A prisoner who fought back on a warrant of eleven minutes or more is reported as having five of their minutes for resisting, when the cap took some or all of them
   - Fix: Carry the minutes actually added for resisting in the outcome and say that number, or leave the clause out when it is nought
381. **[SECT-25](findings/SECT-25-told-to-say-warrant-for-the-clown-which-it-cannot-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Told the clown is in the bar, security answers To declare one, say Warrant for The clown, and then cannot read those very words
   - Fix: Do not offer words the reader refuses, test sightedName's result against NOT_A_NAME, and for a description ask for the name instead
382. **[SECT-26](findings/SECT-26-staff-keep-sending-sightings-of-someone-jailed-or-pardoned-until-the-next-meeting.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Staff go on sending security sightings of someone already jailed or pardoned for up to ten minutes, and security drops them without a word
   - Fix: Have whoever keeps the list answer a sighting of someone no longer wanted with a fixed line that staff read to strike the name from their own list
383. **[SENSE-02](findings/SENSE-02-harm-sense-names-a-janitor-with-a-mop-and-misses-a-gunman.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The harm sense, once switched on, names a janitor with a mop as the one standing over a victim, misses a gunman, and misses a beating spread over seconds
   - Fix: Judge a weapon by what it is (sharp, a gun, a baton, combat mode) not by force alone, look further than one tile for a gun, and compare health against the look of a few seconds ago, not one second ago
384. **[SENSE-04](findings/SENSE-04-blind-or-shut-in-a-locker-keeps-seeing-an-open-door-and-water.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A body that is blinded or shut in a locker forgets what it saw but keeps an open door and water to hand in view, and its people stay just seen for fifteen seconds
   - Fix: Put the clearing of sight in one helper that also resets open_door_in_view, sink_in_view, water_from and bucket_to_fill, and call it from both early returns in look_around
385. **[SIM-03](findings/SIM-03-every-voice-is-one-tile-away-and-facing-is-never-sent.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): In the simulator every crew voice is one tile away and nobody is ever turned away, so who a line was said to is never tested end to end
   - Fix: Give each body a spot in its room, send the real distance between two bodies and a facing flag with every speech_heard, as the server does
386. **[SIM-06](findings/SIM-06-janitor-checks-pass-in-scenarios-with-no-janitors.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Two janitor checks run in every scenario and pass where there are no janitors, and a tool the stand-in does not know is never a failure
   - Fix: Run the two janitor checks only when there are janitors, and count every tool call that reaches the default case as a failed check
387. **[SIM-09](findings/SIM-09-voice-test-sends-prompts-the-game-never-sends.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The model test voice.ts judges prompts the game never sends - no "speaking to you" on any line heard, everyone in view counted as having spoken, and word-for-word lines never marked
   - Fix: Build each voice case's report line with describeEvent from a real speech_heard event, pass only the speaker's handle as speakers, and pass exact from the driver's step
388. **[SIM-10](findings/SIM-10-set-off-too-soon-check-misses-walking-up-and-most-walks.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The check that nobody sets off right after speaking does not count walking up to someone, working a machine, an arrest or five other walks
   - Fix: Build the stand-in's LEAVES from the driver's own rule - every tool but say, hold and those in STAYS - by exporting STAYS from driver.ts
389. **[SIM-11](findings/SIM-11-stand-in-picks-up-from-a-closet-anywhere-without-walking.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in's pick_up takes an item out of any closet the body has ever looked in, from wherever it stands, in two seconds and without moving
   - Fix: Make the stand-in's pick_up from a remembered box walk the body to that box's room first, through the same door and fire-door checks as go_to, and leave the body there
390. **[SUP-14](findings/SUP-14-console-left-on-buy-privately-charges-the-technician.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A supply console left on "buy privately" puts a technician's order on its own bank account, though the money was checked in cargo's budget
   - Fix: In place_order look at console.self_paid, as a player sees it on the screen, and switch it off through the console's own toggleprivate action before adding the order
391. **[SUP-16](findings/SUP-16-pda-refused-for-cuffs-or-the-one-second-wait-is-called-not-working.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A PDA message refused because the body is cuffed or down, or because one went less than a second ago, is reported as the PDA not working and is sent again later on its own
   - Fix: Before send_message_signal, test body.can_perform_action(computer, ALLOW_RESTING) and the messenger's own cooldown, and answer each with its own reason without keeping the message to resend
392. **[SUP-18](findings/SUP-18-order-cancelled-at-the-console-is-taken-for-one-aboard.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): An order someone cancels at the supply console is taken for one loaded aboard, and the technician is told the shuttle has docked without it
   - Fix: Keep the pending order's id as well as its weak reference, and when the order is gone with no shuttle trip since it was placed, end the run as cancelled and say so
393. **[TRA-07](findings/TRA-07-technician-with-no-pda-never-tells-the-quartermaster-face-to-face.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician with no PDA never tells the Quartermaster face to face that an order has come in, is still waiting or is lost, though that word does not go by PDA
   - Fix: Gate the arrived, waiting and lost tasks on having a PDA only when the word would go by PDA, so that word owed to the Quartermaster face to face is owed with or without one
394. **[TRB-10](findings/TRB-10-an-outcome-said-again-for-want-of-i-have-that-is-taken-again-by-the-desk.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An officer's word on a warrant that it says again, because it did not hear I have that, is taken again by the Head of Security, and the Captain and the declarer are told twice
   - Fix: In deskOutcome keep the last few outcome lines heard from each officer with the time, and on the same line again only answer I have that, doing nothing else
395. **[CARGO-19](findings/CARGO-19-order-for-a-captain-with-an-honorific-is-pdad-to-a-name-no-pda-has.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): An order taken at the counter for someone whose ID shows an honorific is held for and messaged to the shown name, which no PDA has, so the crate number never reaches them
   - Fix: In tool_order take order_for from the asker's ID name without the honorific (get_id_name with honorifics FALSE), the name their PDA goes by, falling back to the seen name
396. **[DOOR-08](findings/DOOR-08-named-door-takes-first-of-two-with-one-name.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): Of two doors of a room that go by one name, the first found is opened, not the one the person is standing at
   - Fix: Among the doors that match the name given, take the one the person stands at, or failing that the nearest to them
397. **[DOOR-16](findings/DOOR-16-any-shut-fire-door-in-sight-is-blamed-for-a-failed-walk.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): Any shut fire door in sight is blamed for a walk that found no way, even one nowhere on the way, and that walk is then not counted towards being shut in
   - Fix: In fire_door_report blame only a shut fire door the body can walk up to and that lies nearer the goal than the body does, and pass the walk's goal in so it can tell
398. **[JAN-06](findings/JAN-06-locked-engine-air-alarm-never-unlocks-for-the-body.md)** (not checked, finder likely, engineering): A locked engine air alarm never unlocks for an engineer, because the game checks the ID of usr and the body's click carries none
   - Fix: Make the click in click_as_body as the body with world.push_usr, as work_wires and work_timer already do
399. **[JAN-10](findings/JAN-10-stubborn-mess-list-kept-by-bare-ref-and-never-pruned.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cleaning): Messes given up on are kept by their bare ref for the whole round, so a new mess that is given a dead one's ref is passed over unseen
   - Fix: Keep stubborn_messes as REF to WEAKREF and treat an entry as live only while the weakref resolves to the same mess, and drop dead entries in remember_messes
400. **[JOBS-03](findings/JOBS-03-second-crate-collected-before-the-first-empty-goes-back-loses-the-first.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): Sent for two crates, a body that hauls the second before taking the first empty back leaves the first empty crate where it was unpacked for good
   - Fix: In planPickups, while another collect task of this body is unpacked and an empty is still to go back, a crate not yet hauled waits, so take_back runs first
401. **[MEM-13](findings/MEM-13-shut-in-with-no-head-aboard-it-never-writes-to-the-captain.md)** (not checked, finder likely, memory): Shut in a room with no head of its department aboard, a crew member never sends word to the Captain
   - Fix: In nextToWrite look the head up with headName from jobs/meetings.ts, which falls back to the Captain, instead of headOf and a search of the PDA list
402. **[PARSE-13](findings/PARSE-13-a-head-npc-small-talk-to-security-declares-warrants.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A crew head's small talk with the Head of Security, written by the model, is read as declaring a warrant, keep up the good work and arrest those troublemakers is a warrant on those troublemakers
   - Fix: Have crew heads declare warrants only in the fixed warrantLine words, and have the desk take a spoken line from a head as a warrant only when it begins with the verb or the warrant words, not from words in the middle of a remark
403. **[PERF-09](findings/PERF-09-window-draws-every-card-twice-for-every-update.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The Crew Brain window draws every crew card twice for every update from the server, once before the brains have taken it in and once after, and nothing skips a card that has not changed
   - Fix: Wrap NpcCard in React memo with a compare on the few fields it shows, and run ingest before render or skip the first draw of each update
404. **[QM-13](findings/QM-13-look-report-names-people-and-mess-outside-the-room.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): Sent to look at a room and report, a crew member names as in there everyone and every mess it can see, through windows and doorways into other rooms
   - Fix: In whatIsThere count only people whose place is the room looked at, and say nothing of messes unless the server says which room each is in
405. **[RT-06](findings/RT-06-two-large-brain-log-records-in-one-millisecond-still-collide.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): Two large brain log records sent in the same millisecond still collide, and the second is lost with a duplicate ID runtime
   - Fix: Send every brain_log record through one queue in brain.ts that lets out at most one record every few tens of milliseconds, instead of a fixed 300 ms delay per record
406. **[SEC-10](findings/SEC-10-paw-signal-edit-reaches-listeners-beyond-the-officer.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): The attack_paw edit is heard once, as meant, but it also wakes base-game listeners that never heard a monkey before, and a tackle is told as a shove
   - Fix: Keep the edit, but send it only after the combat-mode and pacifism checks a bite or tackle passes, and tell a monkey's right-click as a tackle, not a shove; the owner to say whether monkeys fighting monkeys back is wanted
407. **[SEC-13](findings/SEC-13-kit-locker-shut-on-whoever-stands-in-it.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): After taking its kit the officer shuts the security locker on anyone standing in it, and leaves it unlocked
   - Fix: Before the closing click in kit_from_locker, leave the locker open if any mob stands on its tile, and lock it again after closing with the click a player uses
408. **[SUP-10](findings/SUP-10-tidying-shuts-the-quartermasters-opened-crate.md)** (not checked, finder likely, quartermaster): The crate the Quartermaster opens for itself is shut again by a tidying technician, with the paper bin back inside where the Quartermaster cannot find it
   - Fix: Have the Quartermaster take what it ordered the crate for out of it before it leaves, and let nearest_paper_bin count a bin in a crate the body may open

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 3

409. **[CHK-05](findings/CHK-05-the-engineering-every-room-gets-the-article.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): The Chief Engineer calls its meeting "in the Engineering" - every room name is given "the", fitting or not
   - Fix: Put the article on through one helper that knows which room names take one, and let the code that reads these lines back accept the name with or without it
410. **[MAP-09](findings/MAP-09-window-table-of-departments-disagrees-with-the-games-own.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): The window's own table of who answers to whom is matched by words inside titles and disagrees with the game's, so a Bridge Assistant and every Assistant are the Head of Personnel's staff and a Chef is nobody's
   - Fix: Have the server send each person's department and head job (from the job datum's departments_list) with the PDA list and the people in view, and drop the hand-written DEPARTMENTS table except as a fallback
411. **[TRUST-09](findings/TRUST-09-who-said-a-line-is-read-back-out-of-the-report-text.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Code reads who said a line back out of the report text, which holds the speaker's own words, so a speaker can make a line look like someone else's
   - Fix: Keep the sense event behind each report line and read the speaker, the handle and the words from its details, never by matching the line's text

---

# Gaps: missing or half built, for you to decide

Not faults in what is there, but things planned and not built, or never thought of. Most need your decision before anyone builds them. Same order: most important first, then the smallest piece of work.

## Gaps: critical (1)

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 1

412. **[HOLE-02](findings/HOLE-02-closing-the-window-wipes-every-brain-for-good.md)** (confirmed, design): Closing the brain window, or the owner dropping off, wipes every crew member's memory for good and nothing says so
   - Fix: Keep a copy of each brain's lasting memory on the server and hand it back when the window opens, log and announce when the window shuts, and open it again by itself when the owner is back

## Gaps: high (14)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 3

413. **[CHK-09](findings/CHK-09-one-planted-throw-stalls-the-whole-simulated-crew.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Shown in the simulator - one error thrown in an after-saying hook leaves the LLM turn taken for good, and every crew member stops talking and most of the work stops
   - Fix: Take DRV-06's fix, and add a simulator run with a planted throw (BRAIN= copy, or a FAULT= switch in sim.ts) to the checks, so the guard it adds is tested and stays tested
414. **[CORE-04](findings/CORE-04-one-runtime-in-ui-data-stops-the-window-for-every-body.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): One runtime error in ui_data, from any of its forty calls for any one body, stops every update to the window, so every crew member stalls while it lasts
   - Fix: Build each body's record in its own proc inside try and catch, and on an error log it once and send a short record for that body with an error field, so the others still get their update
415. **[MAP-01](findings/MAP-01-first-round-to-reach-the-shuttle-sends-the-next-to-kilostation.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The first test round that sees the emergency shuttle leave makes the next round KiloStation, where the crew has never been run
   - Fix: Pin the test server to MetaStation in config/maps.txt (the only votable map, with no minplayers) until the crew is checked on other maps, and say so in the change log, since the MAPROTATION flag is read by nothing

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 7

416. **[DRV-06](findings/DRV-06-one-thrown-error-stops-every-brain.md)** (confirmed, driver): One thrown error anywhere in the window code, for any one NPC, stops every brain for good and then costs all their memory
   - Fix: Catch errors per NPC in ingest and round the whole of think, chooseJob and readOrder, log them through brain_log, always free the LLM turn in a finally, and escape names built into RegExps
417. **[GAP-02](findings/GAP-02-crate-unpacked-by-forcemove-without-opening-it.md)** (confirmed, supply): A collected crate is unpacked by moving its contents in code, without opening it (no-cheats plan 4.6, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Open the crate by the click a player uses, leave everything on its tile, pull the open crate one tile clear, shut it, and take it back
418. **[GAP-04](findings/GAP-04-janitors-still-spawn-in-galoshes-and-nobody-walks-on-wet-floor.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Janitors are still given galoshes at spawn, and the plan's way to remove them clashes with the owner's ruling that a mopped floor is not seen (no-cheats plan 4.5 and 4.1)
   - Fix: Ask the owner whether a janitor may know the tiles it has just mopped, build that in knows_slippery, see it in a round, then delete the shoe swap in create_crew_npc
419. **[GAP-07](findings/GAP-07-no-cheats-read-through-and-check-script-never-done.md)** (confirmed, tools): The read-through for cheats and the check script that fails on new ones were approved and never done (no-cheats plan 4.9), a list of what is left
   - Fix: Add tools/llm_crew/cheats.ts that greps the crew code for a short list of calls against an allowed list, and put the list below to the owner
420. **[HOLE-11](findings/HOLE-11-body-never-presses-resist-unless-crew-security-arrested-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A crew member strapped to a chair, shut in a locker, set alight or cuffed by a player never tries to get free
   - Fix: Add one reflex to the body, run from look_around, that presses Resist the way a player would when it is buckled by someone else, shut in a container, on fire, or in cuffs with nobody holding it, and tells the brain what happened
421. **[MAP-03](findings/MAP-03-no-cargo-lobby-on-kilo-and-catwalk-stops-all-supply.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): KiloStation and CatwalkStation have no Cargo Lobby, so no crate can be put out, asked for at the counter, collected or brought back
   - Fix: Have the server work out the counter room from the post (the room on the far side of the service window or desk nearest the post spot), send its name to the brain as the counter, and use that name everywhere the window says Cargo Lobby
422. **[QM-07](findings/QM-07-given-order-has-no-deadline.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): An order a technician has said it has is waited on with no time limit, so any word that does not come back leaves that technician busy and the money spoken for until the round ends
   - Fix: Give a taken order a deadline past the server's six-minute shuttle limit, after which the Quartermaster asks the technician face to face whether it has come in, and failing an answer puts it back to be given again and tells whoever ordered

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 4

423. **[GAP-01](findings/GAP-01-supply-shuttle-still-moved-by-timer-and-by-code.md)** (confirmed, cargo): The supply shuttle is still sent and called home by code, from wherever the technician is (no-cheats plan 4.7, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Press send through work_window at the console as the owner allowed for machine windows, drop the timer that moves the shuttle, and make an order two presses at the console
424. **[GAP-05](findings/GAP-05-fire-doors-nobody-asks-engineering-and-server-says-if-alarm-is-real.md)** (confirmed, doors): Fire doors, the owner's chain to engineering is not built, and the server still tells every body whether an alarm is real
   - Fix: Drop crew_npc_alarm_was_pulled, reset once and leave the room if the doors shut again, and build the ask up the chain to an engineer who pries the door
425. **[HOLE-06](findings/HOLE-06-when-pdas-stop-nobody-walks-over-to-say-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): When PDA messages stop going out the crew are never told, word owed by PDA is dropped after eight minutes, and nobody walks over to say it
   - Fix: Tell the window when the body's PDA has not been sending, treat that as having no PDA, keep word that did not go, and add one general step that carries word to someone in person
426. **[HOLE-08](findings/HOLE-08-the-dead-and-the-silent-are-counted-on-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Whoever a PDA lists first with the job is "the officer" or "the head" for ever, whether they are dead, a player who does not answer, or a PDA in a locker
   - Fix: Keep, for each person a crew member relies on, a count of words sent and not answered and whether they were last seen down, pass over anyone who fails it when picking who holds a job, and tell its own head or the Captain once when someone has stopped answering

## Gaps: medium (59)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 9

427. **[ENG-10](findings/ENG-10-cooling-is-not-looked-at-again-before-the-emitters-go-on.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The engineer never looks again at the cooling it set before it switches the emitters on, though the server tells it how every machine in view stands
   - Fix: Before each emitter step, take back out of engine.done any step whose machine is in view and seen not to be as it was set, so that it is done again before the emitters
428. **[HOLE-04](findings/HOLE-04-no-admin-at-round-start-means-no-crew-all-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): With no admin connected ten seconds into the round there is no crew all round, and nothing is logged
   - Fix: Log why no crew was spawned, try again when an admin who may spawn connects, and name the owner in config instead of taking the first admin on the list
429. **[HOLE-12](findings/HOLE-12-what-the-body-answered-to-each-step-is-logged-nowhere.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The logs say what each crew member was told to do and almost never how it went, so a round cannot be read back
   - Fix: Write every action result to the round's crew brain log from the server, with the tool, whether it went, and the words, and log tool calls the rate limit drops
430. **[KNA-08](findings/KNA-08-hurt-officer-with-a-baton-does-not-defend-itself.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A hurt officer with a working baton walks away from someone who follows and keeps hitting it
   - Fix: Let a hurt officer that is struck again while getting away stop its attacker with the baton, in self-defence only, if the owner agrees
431. **[KNA-21](findings/KNA-21-captains-pardon-to-the-officers-face-is-sent-on-not-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The Captain pardoning someone to the officer's face, with the prisoner in sight, is told to take it to the Head of Security, and nothing is done
   - Fix: Let an officer act on a pardon from the Captain itself, and pass it to the Head of Security as news, if the owner agrees that the Captain outranks the list
432. **[KNA-25](findings/KNA-25-staff-hear-of-a-warrant-only-at-the-next-meeting-read-out-before-the-wanted.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Staff hear of a warrant only at their head's next meeting, up to ten minutes late, and the list is read out with the wanted person standing in the room
   - Fix: Have a head pass a new name on the list to its staff by PDA at once, and leave out of the meeting line anyone on the list who is in the room, if the owner agrees
433. **[PARSE-10](findings/PARSE-10-captain-cannot-order-the-emitters-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The Captain cannot have the engine shut down - turn the emitters off, shut down the engine and kill the engine are read by nobody, to the Chief Engineer or the engineer
   - Fix: Read a shut-down order from anyone the Chief Engineer answers to, as LIGHT_AGAIN_WORDS is read, and have it give the engineer the same Emitters off order as a falling crystal does
434. **[SECT-20](findings/SECT-20-someone-walked-out-who-comes-straight-back-is-asked-afresh-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone walked out of a post who comes straight back in is a stranger again, is asked why from the start, and is never reported however often they return
   - Fix: Keep a short record of who was put out of the post and when, walk a returner out without asking again, and tell the head the second time they come back
435. **[HOLE-16](findings/HOLE-16-crew-locked-in-a-cell-by-a-player-do-not-know-they-are-prisoners.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A crew member locked in a brig cell by the Captain or any player does not know it is a prisoner, goes on with its work from the cell and asks to be let out
   - Fix: In look_around, when the body stands in a brig cell whose timer is running and it is in no custody, put it in custody of that cell the way put_in_custody does, with nobody named, so the existing cell phase holds it and lets it go when the timer stops

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 36

436. **[ARR-16](findings/ARR-16-looking-for-someone-is-standing-at-the-near-end-of-the-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Looking for someone in a room or a hallway is standing at its near end for 20 or 10 seconds, so in any big room they are not found and the sighting is spent
   - Fix: Walk the room or hallway end to end, in a few go_to steps to spots spread through it, before a sighting is counted as looked at or a hallway as walked
437. **[CARGO-20](findings/CARGO-20-a-player-quartermaster-cannot-get-a-technician-to-order-anything.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A player who is Quartermaster cannot get a technician to order anything except in the NPC Quartermaster's exact words, and is told nothing it can answer in its own
   - Fix: When the Quartermaster aboard is not one of this window's NPCs, offer the model the order option for the Quartermaster's own asking, and take any plain acknowledgement from it as heard
438. **[CHK-02](findings/CHK-02-no-crew-test-runs-by-itself.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): None of the crew tests runs by itself - not in the build, not in CI, and the tools folder is never type checked or linted
   - Fix: Add one runner script that runs the tables, the dry model tests and the simulator scenarios and exits non-zero on any failure, and hang the quick part of it on the tgui test target
439. **[DESK-06](findings/DESK-06-called-to-a-locked-room-by-anyone-not-in-cargo-the-janitor-never-asks-in.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Called to a mess in a room locked to it by anyone but cargo, a janitor walks at the door every few minutes, never knocks or asks, and never tells the caller
   - Fix: Give any told mess task the let-in steps once a walk to its room fails for want of a way in, whoever called, and let anyone coming into view restart the asking, not only cargo
440. **[GAP-08](findings/GAP-08-order-asked-while-door-or-pickup-is-in-hand-is-still-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): An order asked of a technician while someone wants a door or a crate is still lost (no-cheats plan 4.2, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Keep the ask in code when hears() is turned away by a door or a pick-up, tell the LLM the truth meanwhile, and place it from the kept words once the door is done
441. **[GAP-09](findings/GAP-09-janitor-call-and-let-out-words-do-not-say-what-is-true.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A technician still does not know its workmate called a janitor, and a janitor leaving for water still says "I am done" (no-cheats plan 4.3, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Send who called whom in place of the yes or no, word the waiting step with it, and give the let-out message its true reason (done, dry mop, cannot shift it)
442. **[GAP-13](findings/GAP-13-nobody-notices-anyone-hurt-down-or-dead-the-harm-senses-are-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Nobody notices a person hurt, down or dead, the harm senses were written and never switched on
   - Fix: Call watch_for_harm from look_around for people in view, and build the one use the plans name, any crew member who sees someone lying still tells its head or the Captain once
443. **[GAP-14](findings/GAP-14-janitors-do-not-put-trespassers-out-of-their-own-rooms.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Janitors do not question or put out a trespasser in the Custodial Closet, the owner asked for it on 2026-11-18 and keeping a room is tied to having a post
   - Fix: Give every body a list of rooms it keeps (its department's locked rooms), key the guarding code on that list instead of the post, and add guarding to the janitor job
444. **[GAP-15](findings/GAP-15-loose-wording-is-forgiven-only-for-warrants-sent-by-pda.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Loose wording and bad spelling are understood only for warrants and pardons sent to security by PDA, every other typed order still needs the exact words
   - Fix: Lift the forgiving speller and the small LLM reader out of security into shared code, and give each job's order reader a list of the orders it takes so the same last-resort question serves all of them
445. **[GAP-17](findings/GAP-17-nobody-leaves-a-room-for-bad-air-and-other-secure-area-leftovers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): No body leaves a room because its air has turned bad or its alarm is ringing, and four more leftovers of the locked-areas plan
   - Fix: Have the server say when the air on the body's own tile is not fit to stand in, and have the driver treat that as the one emergency that comes before any job, walking to the nearest room it knows with good air
446. **[GAP-24](findings/GAP-24-a-pda-message-no-reader-knows-gets-no-answer-at-all.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A PDA message never wakes the voice, so anything sent by PDA that no job's reader knows gets no answer and no action, the Captain's orders to heads included
   - Fix: Have readsMessage say whether it used the message, and for one from a person that no reader used send a fixed acknowledgement by PDA, with the voice wording it when the model is up and GAP-15's reader trying it as an order
447. **[HOLE-03](findings/HOLE-03-crew-are-not-on-the-stations-books.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The crew are made outside the job system, so they hold no job slot, are not on the manifest and have no records or bank account
   - Fix: Give each body a mind and its job through SSjob when it is spawned, take the job's slot, and put it on the manifest, and skip any job a player already holds
448. **[HOLE-10](findings/HOLE-10-crew-of-two-owners-do-not-know-each-other-for-crew.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Crew owned by two players do not know each other for crew, and nobody can take over a crew whose owner has left
   - Fix: Have the server say of each person seen and heard whether they are a crew NPC, use that in place of "is in my window", and add an admin verb that hands a crew to another owner
449. **[HOLE-13](findings/HOLE-13-a-player-doing-a-crew-job-stalls-whoever-hands-them-work.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): A player holding a crew job is handed work like an NPC, and work waits for ever on set words a player will never say
   - Fix: Take any answer from the person a job was given to as their word that they have it, give a job that goes unanswered to someone else after a set number of tries, and call to a staff meeting only those who have answered a call before
450. **[HOLE-15](findings/HOLE-15-crew-never-see-an-emote-a-point-or-anything-done-in-front-of-them.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The crew never see an emote, a point, or any of the game's "X does Y" lines, so a player who points at a mess, waves someone over or nods yes is not seen at all
   - Fix: When a person comes into view register for COMSIG_MOB_EMOTE and COMSIG_MOVABLE_POINTED on them, and emit a seen sense event with what they did and at what, for the window to keep as context and for the readers to use
451. **[HOLE-17](findings/HOLE-17-a-crew-member-arrested-by-a-player-walks-off-to-its-work.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A crew member arrested by a player, the Captain or a human officer, is not held, walks off to its work, and is only told so in its prompt
   - Fix: Give the body one general way to be arrested by anyone it answers to, read from what it hears and feels, which holds it still the way being_arrested does and lets it go on the same rules, and read the arrest words loosely
452. **[HOLE-19](findings/HOLE-19-requests-made-at-the-game-request-consoles-are-never-seen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Supplies asked for the game's own way, at a supply request console, are never seen by cargo, so a player who orders as players do waits for good
   - Fix: Have a technician standing at its supply console read the console's request list the way its screen shows it, and pass each new request to the Quartermaster as an order taken from its orderer, approving it at the console once the Quartermaster says yes
453. **[HOLE-20](findings/HOLE-20-messages-to-a-department-requests-console-are-never-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A message sent to Janitorial, Security or Engineering at a wall requests console is never read, the console says aloud only who it is from, and the crew take that for machine chatter
   - Fix: When a crew body hears its own department's requests console announce a message, have it go to the console, read the newest message the way its screen shows it, and hand the text to the same readers a PDA message goes to
454. **[KNA-07](findings/KNA-07-officer-with-no-fresh-word-walks-only-primary-hallways.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): With no fresh word of a suspect the officer walks only rooms named Primary Hallway, and never looks beside where they were last seen
   - Fix: Look first in the rooms that open onto the room of the last sighting, then walk every hallway the station has, by kind of room and not by name
455. **[KNA-11](findings/KNA-11-engineer-does-not-force-the-room-in-between.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer sent to a door behind another locked room says so and stops, when it could force the outer door first
   - Fix: When the server says the way is through another locked room, force that room's door first and then go on to the door that was asked for
456. **[KNA-16](findings/KNA-16-janitors-cannot-put-anyone-out-of-their-closet.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Janitors do not question or put out someone who has no business in the Custodial Closet, because guarding is tied to having a post
   - Fix: Guard any locked room of the body's own department that it is standing in, not only a post it is stationed at
457. **[KNA-18](findings/KNA-18-shuttle-barred-technician-knows-why-and-does-nothing.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): When the supply shuttle will not leave, the technician is told what is barring it and has no step to clear it, and the Captain is not told
   - Fix: Give the technician a step for each thing what_bars_shuttle can name - carry a loose thing off the deck, ask a person to step off - and have the Quartermaster tell the Captain when an order has been held up
458. **[KNB-11](findings/KNB-11-no-engineer-no-engine-and-no-reading-no-watch.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): With no engineer free to do it nobody lights the engine, and with no PDA reading the Chief Engineer never orders the emitters off
   - Fix: Let the Chief Engineer take the engineer's lighting list itself when no engineer has taken the order, and go and look at the crystal when the monitor has told it nothing for some minutes
459. **[KNB-12](findings/KNB-12-locked-room-rules-are-given-out-job-by-job.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Having rooms of your own is handed out job by job, so janitors put nobody out of the Custodial Closet and cannot open their own door for anyone
   - Fix: Work out a body's own rooms from its ID and its job's department for every job, and let anyone with rooms of their own guard them and open their doors
460. **[MAP-08](findings/MAP-08-tramstation-crew-know-nothing-of-the-tram-or-its-crossings.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): On Tramstation the crew know nothing of the tram, so they cross the tracks without looking at the crossing signal and cannot ride it between the station's parts
   - Fix: Treat a tram track tile as a place to step onto only when the nearest crossing signal is green, as a player would, and leave riding the tram to the lift work in HOLE-05
461. **[PARSE-02](findings/PARSE-02-a-room-is-only-known-by-its-whole-exact-name.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A room is found in what was said only by its whole exact name, so medbay, the captains office, the hop office, the dorms and hydro name no room
   - Fix: Give placeNamedIn a forgiving match - apostrophes optional, a room's distinctive word alone when only one room has it, and a short table of the usual station shorthands (hop, ce, qm, hydro, dorms, medbay)
462. **[PARSE-05](findings/PARSE-05-common-ways-to-order-an-arrest-are-not-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Cuff Bob, brig Bob, Bob needs arresting, I want Bob arrested, bring Dana in and arrest the monkey are none of them read as a warrant
   - Fix: Add the missing verbs and the passive and wish forms to readWarrant, read bring X in with the name between, and let the X be a job or the monkey when exactly one known person fits
463. **[SEC-14](findings/SEC-14-prisoner-held-while-the-officer-waits-works-the-cuffs-off-unseen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A player held by the arm while the officer stands waiting works the cuffs off in a minute and walks away, and the officer never sees it start
   - Fix: While the body holds someone it arrested, listen on them for COMSIG_MOB_REMOVING_CUFFS, tell the brain what any onlooker sees, and have the officer break the attempt by a step or a tighter grip
464. **[SENSE-03](findings/SENSE-03-crew-see-no-one-who-is-not-human.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Crew see nobody who is not human, a cyborg talking to them, a space carp biting them or a xenomorph in their room is not in view at all
   - Fix: Report every living mob in view in look_around, humans as now and the rest as creatures with kind, name and whether hostile, and let handle_for take any mob/living
465. **[SENSE-09](findings/SENSE-09-fire-smoke-and-anomalies-are-not-seen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Fire, smoke and anomalies are never seen, so a body walks into flames and goes on mopping beside a burning room without a word
   - Fix: In look_around report hotspots, smoke and anomalies in sight as a hazard list, and keep the walk and the idle step off burning tiles
466. **[SIM-07](findings/SIM-07-stand-in-model-never-hangs-cuts-off-or-talks-nonsense.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in model answers every call in two and a half seconds with whole, well-formed JSON, so a slow, hung, cut-off or wayward model is never simulated
   - Fix: Add stand-in model modes slow, hung, cutoff, junk and wayward, honour the abort signal, and run the long scenarios in each
467. **[DOOR-05](findings/DOOR-05-free-exit-doors-not-known-to-the-crew.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): A door that lets anyone out from one side is taken as locked, so a body asks to be let out of somewhere it could walk out of
   - Fix: Teach the route planner that an airlock opens from its free-exit side, or failing that have a shut-in body look for such a door of its room and walk into it
468. **[HAND-10](findings/HAND-10-crate-jammed-in-a-doorway-is-cleared-for-a-walk-but-never-for-an-errand.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): A crate jammed in a doorway is moved when it shuts a walk, but never when it shuts an errand, so a held crate behind it is written off as one nobody can get to
   - Fix: When an errand's walk finds no way, try clear_the_way as walk_finished does before giving the errand up, with the errand kept in after_clearing to be taken up again
469. **[PERF-05](findings/PERF-05-one-model-is-a-quarter-busy-at-eleven-and-full-before-forty.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The one model was a quarter busy with eleven crew and will be full before forty, and then every job choice costs its body eight seconds for nothing and every fixed line waits its turn for an optional remark
   - Fix: Under load, say a fixed line at once without its remark, skip the job choice when the talk queue is not empty, give a player's line the front of the queue, and log each call's wait in the queue
470. **[SECT-17](findings/SECT-17-no-hand-over-of-the-list-between-an-officer-and-a-head-of-security.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): When a Head of Security comes aboard after an officer has kept the list, or leaves after it, the list is not handed over, and the old warrants drop out of sight
   - Fix: Have whoever stops keeping the list send it to whoever takes it up, in the fixed words of the notice, and have the new keeper read that notice into its desk
471. **[TRUST-10](findings/TRUST-10-crew-do-not-notice-their-id-taken-off-them.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): A crew member stands still while its ID card or PDA is taken off it, tells nobody, and then no longer knows its own job, while the thief is that head to every other crew member
   - Fix: Have every body notice when its card, PDA or bag leaves it for someone else's hands, tell the brain who took it, and keep the job it was given at spawn as its own whatever card it holds

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 14

472. **[GAP-06](findings/GAP-06-workmates-share-lists-in-code-that-no-body-could-sense.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Workmates share lists in code that no body saw, heard or was sent (the brief's decision 4 has quietly stopped being true)
   - Fix: Ask the owner whether a department's shared list is allowed, then either write the exception into the brief or carry each list by speech, PDA or something the body can read
473. **[GAP-10](findings/GAP-10-water-by-cart-the-cart-crate-and-a-bucket-asked-for-not-built.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Carrying water, the cart is never pulled or filled, cargo cannot order one, and a janitor short of a bucket tells nobody (no-cheats plan 4.4 and 4.1, half built)
   - Fix: Add the cart crate to orderable_crates, tell the head of a missing bucket as a need that does not stop work, then build pulling and filling a cart on the crate-hauling code
474. **[GAP-11](findings/GAP-11-light-replacer-plan-not-built-at-all.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): The light replacer (LLM_CREW_PLAN_LIGHTS.md), all six decisions accepted, none of it built
   - Fix: Build the plan's seven steps in its own order, starting with the server seeing dead fixtures by room
475. **[GAP-16](findings/GAP-16-security-plan-leftovers-in-one-list.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Security, what the two plans decided or proposed and is still not built, in one list
   - Fix: Take the small ones (cuffs collected, a freed prisoner seen out, the sighting answered, a follow order) in one sitting and put the rest to the owner as a list
476. **[GAP-19](findings/GAP-19-engineering-answers-no-calls-and-no-fault-is-handed-on-between-jobs.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): Engineering lights the engine and nothing else, no power call is taken and no fault is handed on between jobs (engineering plan stages 2 and 3, and the owner's lights-out example)
   - Fix: Build stage 2 as a shared reporting duty plus a list of calls on the Chief Engineer, starting with the one call the game makes easy, a room's breaker that is off
477. **[GAP-22](findings/GAP-22-tests-the-plans-promised-and-never-wrote-or-ran.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Tests the plans promised and never wrote or ran, no server code is ever exercised, the model has never been asked the new questions, and two scenarios fail by chance
   - Fix: Write the scenarios the plans list as the fixes for them are built, run the model cases once with the card free, pin the simulator's randomness so a failing run can be replayed, and add a checklist round for server code
478. **[HOLE-07](findings/HOLE-07-crew-hear-no-station-announcement-and-never-evacuate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The crew hear no station announcement, so nobody goes to the emergency shuttle or takes note of an alert level
   - Fix: Give every conscious body on the station a sense event for each station announcement, and build one shared duty on top of it, going to the shuttle when it is called
479. **[SEC-08](findings/SEC-08-brig-with-no-power-holds-prisoners-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): When the brig loses power a prisoner is never let out, a pardon is dropped without a word, and a new prisoner is held by the arm for ever
   - Fix: Tell the brain a cell is dead (reason no_power), have security say so to its head and the Captain, and give it a player's way to open a dead cell door
480. **[SIM-04](findings/SIM-04-failure-paths-the-stand-in-server-can-never-give.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in server never gives most of the failures the real tools give, so the window code that handles them has never run
   - Fix: Give the stand-in a per-tool table of the real failures and a FAULTS switch that makes a named one happen, then add one scenario per job that runs with faults on
481. **[GAP-18](findings/GAP-18-cargo-and-quartermaster-plan-leftovers-in-one-list.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): Cargo and the Quartermaster, what five plans left unbuilt, in one list (an uncollected order is never sent back, the stuck shuttle is told to nobody, and more)
   - Fix: Build the uncollected order going back and the Quartermaster telling the Captain of a stuck shuttle first, both small, and put the rest to the owner as a list
482. **[HOLE-05](findings/HOLE-05-nothing-works-on-a-station-with-more-than-one-floor.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): On a station with more than one floor the crew cannot leave the floor they are spawned on, and jobs whose rooms are on another floor get no post
   - Fix: Turn on the route planner's multi-floor routes for crew, look for rooms on every station level, and send a body to the nearest floor of a room that it can reach
483. **[HOLE-09](findings/HOLE-09-what-breaks-first-with-a-whole-station-of-crew.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): A whole station of crew will not fit through one window as built, since every event from any body resends every body's whole state, and the brain log drops records without saying so
   - Fix: Send each body's slow-changing state on a timer and only its new events at once, count the brain log limit per body and log what is dropped, and measure the payload before adding more crew
484. **[HOLE-14](findings/HOLE-14-a-crew-member-given-a-new-job-is-half-old-job-half-new.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): A crew member whose ID is given a new job, promoted to replace a dead head or demoted, is run by the new job in the window and the old one on the server
   - Fix: Have the server notice when the job on the body's own worn ID changes, learn that job's places again and send a knowledge event, and have the window start the new job's state fresh and drop the old job's tasks
485. **[SIM-05](findings/SIM-05-what-no-scenario-covers-by-job.md)** (not checked, finder likely, tools): What no scenario or table covers, by job, and no run is longer than 23 minutes
   - Fix: Add the scenarios listed here, most important first, each with checks that can fail, and one long scenario of an hour with power lost part way

## Gaps: low (17)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 11

486. **[CHK-03](findings/CHK-03-stale-compiled-tree-can-be-loaded-unnoticed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The crew's behaviour tree is read from a compiled copy on disk that the side compile does not rebuild and that cannot be checked on this machine
   - Fix: Add the tree check to the list of checks, with a command that works under Python 3.11, and mend the comment that says which defines the tree compiler reads
487. **[DESK-07](findings/DESK-07-word-that-a-mess-is-cleaned-goes-only-face-to-face.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Word that a mess someone called the janitor to is cleaned up is only ever said face to face, so a caller by PDA who is not there is never told
   - Fix: When a told mess task is done and the caller is not in view, send the sayDone line by PDA once, as orders.ts does for a report, and mark it reported
488. **[GAP-21](findings/GAP-21-the-brief-no-longer-describes-the-system-decisions-one-to-nine-checked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The brief no longer describes the system, its nine decisions checked against today's code (three reversed on purpose and never written into it, three quietly untrue)
   - Fix: Rewrite sections 2, 5 and 6 of the brief to say what is true now, with the date and the owner's words for each reversal, and list what the brief promised that is still unbuilt
489. **[GAP-26](findings/GAP-26-plan-headers-and-change-log-summary-say-built-work-is-not-built.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): Six plans still open with "Planning only, nothing here is built", the no-cheats plan has no Status section, and the change log's summary calls two built plans unbuilt
   - Fix: Give the no-cheats plan a Status section at the top that says what is built (4.1, the mail chute, the water half of 4.4), change the six opening lines to point at the Status, and correct the change log's summary in a new top entry
490. **[HAND-06](findings/HAND-06-search-and-fetch-call-any-locker-that-will-not-open-locked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): Searching and fetching call any locker that will not open locked, welded or blocked alike, and never unlock one the body's own card opens
   - Fix: Open storage with the click a player makes, so a locker its card opens is unlocked first, and report welded, blocked and locked apart
491. **[HEAD-11](findings/HEAD-11-staff-known-only-from-the-pda-list.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): A head knows its staff only from its PDA's list, so a janitor with no PDA asking it face to face is ignored, and a head with no PDA has no staff, holds no meetings and orders nothing
   - Fix: Make staff() the PDA list joined with everyone in view whose ID puts them in the head's department, so word given face to face counts and the no-PDA paths in meetStep can run
492. **[JAN-11](findings/JAN-11-tidying-takes-things-from-under-and-beside-people.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): Tidying takes anything off the floor with no thought for whose it is, things a person has just put down, is standing on, or that fell from someone lying hurt
   - Fix: In wants_tidying leave alone a thing on or next to a tile with a living person other than the body, and ask the owner whether a fresh drop should be left a minute
493. **[KNA-27](findings/KNA-27-first-try-on-a-monkey-is-the-cuffs-alone.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The first go at anyone, a monkey included, is "Stand still" and the cuffs alone, which a monkey never stands for, so one of the three tries is spent for nothing
   - Fix: Send in each person in view whether they are a person or an animal, as the body sees it, and go straight to the baton for one that cannot be told to stand still, if the owner agrees
494. **[KNB-17](findings/KNB-17-thing-put-in-a-pocket-is-never-noticed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A thing Pun Pun puts in a crew member's pocket is never noticed or put down, only one put in a hand is
   - Fix: Let on_item_in_hand also take the two pocket slots, and have put_down_unasked_item take the thing out of the pocket by a click before it sets it down
495. **[PERF-04](findings/PERF-04-nothing-measures-what-the-crew-costs-the-server.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): Nothing measures what the crew costs the server, and the round's perf csv cannot show it, so a forty-crew round would show only lag with no cause
   - Fix: Count the time and the calls of ui_data, look_around and the sends to the window, and the bytes sent, and write them once a minute as one crew_cost line in game.log
496. **[QM-15](findings/QM-15-captain-asked-about-orders-the-budget-cannot-pay.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): The Captain is asked twice to approve every order that the budget cannot pay at all, which at the start of a round is every order, since cargo starts with nothing
   - Fix: In clearOrders test the money first, hold an order the budget cannot cover and tell whoever ordered, and put it to the Captain only once it can be paid and is still big

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 5

497. **[CARGO-17](findings/CARGO-17-no-crew-member-ever-comes-for-their-mail.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): No crew member ever comes for their mail, because no job reads the there is mail for you message, and a technician's own letter is sent to itself by PDA
   - Fix: Give the mail notice fixed words that every job reads in readPickup's way, so the person goes to the counter when free, and leave out the technician's own name from the mail it messages about
498. **[JAN-08](findings/JAN-08-engine-machine-list-worked-out-once-and-never-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The engine room's machines are worked out once a round, so a canister swapped onto a connector, or an emitter welded later, is never known, and the old one is walked to wherever it went
   - Fix: Work the canister and emitter entries out again when looked at - by the connector, not the canister - or rebuild the list when an entry no longer fits, keeping ids stable for the machines that did not change
499. **[JAN-12](findings/JAN-12-mopped-floor-left-wet-with-no-caution-sign.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Every tile a janitor mops is left slippery for up to a minute with no caution sign put out, and nothing warns anyone walking in
   - Fix: Ask the owner - put a wet floor sign (obj/item/clothing/suit/caution) down by the mopping when the janitor has one, and pick it up after, or say Wet floor aloud, as a player janitor does
500. **[MAP-10](findings/MAP-10-simulator-has-one-station-with-metastation-names.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The simulator has one station, with MetaStation's room names written in, so nothing that depends on the map is ever tested and every map fault passes
   - Fix: Make the station in sim.ts a table chosen by name, add a second one with other names (no Cargo Lobby, no room called Brig, hallways not called Primary Hallway), and run the cargo and security scenarios on both
501. **[DESK-11](findings/DESK-11-janitors-share-out-no-work-and-go-to-the-same-mess-together.md)** (not checked, finder likely, janitor): Janitors share out no work, so two that have seen the same messes go to the same room in the same order, and neither leaves a room to another already in it
   - Fix: Leave a routine mess task alone for a while when another janitor is seen in that room, or is seen cleaning there, and let the order of rooms differ by janitor

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 1

502. **[GAP-25](findings/GAP-25-owner-design-direction-items-with-no-plan-and-no-code.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Six parts of the owner's design direction have no plan and no code, needs, how-to cards, a stocked work area, cover before a break, rooms handed out to janitors, and a raise
   - Fix: Put the six to the owner as one list, and write a short plan for whichever the owner wants next, starting with the head handing out rooms to its janitors, which is the cheapest and helps today
